question: The size of an A4 drawing sheet is:
explanation: A-series: A0 = 1189×841, A1 = 841×594, A2 = 594×420, A3 = 420×297, A4 = 297×210 mm. Each size is half the previous one.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: A4 ड्रइङ सिटको आकार कति हुन्छ?

question: The size of an A0 drawing sheet is:
explanation: A0 is the largest A-series sheet (area 1 m²); each smaller size is obtained by halving the longer side.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: A0 ड्रइङ सिटको आकार कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: A0 सबैभन्दा ठूलो A-श्रृंखला सिट हो (क्षेत्रफल १ वर्ग मिटर); प्रत्येक सानो आकार लामो पक्ष आधा गरेर प्राप्त हुन्छ।

question: The ratio of the longer side to the shorter side of an A-series sheet is:
explanation: A-series sheets keep the ratio √2:1, so halving the sheet preserves the same proportions.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: A-श्रृंखला सिटको लामो पक्ष र छोटो पक्षको अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: A-श्रृंखला सिटले √२:१ अनुपात राख्छ, त्यसैले सिट आधा गर्दा पनि उही अनुपात रहन्छ।

question: A scale of 1:2 in engineering drawing is a:
explanation: 1:2 means the drawing is half the actual size (reducing); 2:1 is enlarging; 1:1 is full scale.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ ड्रइङमा १:२ स्केल कस्तो हो?
explanation_ne: १:२ भनेको ड्रइङ वास्तविक आकारको आधा हो (घटाउने); २:१ बढाउने हो; १:१ पूर्ण स्केल हो।

question: The representative fraction (RF) of a 1:50 scale is:
explanation: RF = drawing size / actual size = 1/50 for a 1:50 scale.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १:५० स्केलको प्रतिनिधि भिन्न (RF) कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: RF = ड्रइङ आकार / वास्तविक आकार = १:५० स्केलका लागि १/५०।

question: A diagonal scale is used to measure:
options: Three units (e.g. metres, decimetres and centimetres)
explanation: A diagonal scale reads three successive units by the diagonal division principle — e.g. m, dm and cm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विकर्ण स्केल कुन नाप्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: तीन एकाइ (जस्तै मिटर, डेसिमिटर र सेन्टिमिटर)
explanation_ne: विकर्ण स्केलले विकर्ण विभाजन सिद्धान्तबाट तीन क्रमिक एकाइ पढ्छ — जस्तै मिटर, डेसिमिटर र सेन्टिमिटर।

question: Which line type is used for visible outlines in engineering drawing?
explanation: Visible edges and outlines are drawn with a continuous thick line; hidden edges use dashed lines.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ ड्रइङमा देखिने रूपरेखाका लागि कुन रेखा प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: देखिने किनारा र रूपरेखा निरन्तर बाक्लो रेखाले कोइन्छ; लुकेका किनारा धर्से रेखाले कोइन्छ।

question: Hidden edges in a drawing are shown by:
explanation: Hidden lines are short dashes of medium thickness, showing edges that are not visible in that view.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा लुकेका किनारा के ले देखाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: लुकेका रेखा मध्यम मोटाइका छोटा धर्सा हुन्छन्, जसले त्यो दृश्यमा नदेखिने किनारा देखाउँछन्।

question: Centre lines and axes are drawn with:
explanation: Centre lines are long-dash-dot thin lines extending slightly beyond the object.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: केन्द्र रेखा र अक्ष के ले कोइन्छ?
explanation_ne: केन्द्र रेखा लामो-धर्सा-बिन्दु पातलो रेखा हुन् जुन वस्तुभन्दा अलि बाहिरसम्म जान्छन्।

question: Dimension lines and extension lines are drawn with:
explanation: Dimension, extension, leader and hatching lines are all continuous thin lines.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मापन रेखा र विस्तार रेखा के ले कोइन्छ?
explanation_ne: मापन, विस्तार, लिडर र ह्याचिङ रेखा सबै निरन्तर पातलो रेखा हुन्।

question: Section (hatching) lines are drawn at an angle of:
explanation: Hatching is done with thin lines at 45° to the outline, spaced evenly (2–3 mm apart).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खण्ड (ह्याचिङ) रेखा मुख्य रूपरेखासँग कति कोणमा कोइन्छ?
explanation_ne: ह्याचिङ पातलो रेखाले रूपरेखासँग ४५° मा गरिन्छ, समान अन्तर (२–३ मिमि) मा।

question: In first-angle projection, the top view is placed:
options: To the left of the front view
explanation: In first-angle projection the object is in the first quadrant and the view from above is placed below the front view. Nepal and India use first-angle projection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पहिलो-कोण प्रक्षेपणमा माथिल्लो दृश्य कहाँ राखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: पहिलो-कोण प्रक्षेपणमा वस्तु पहिलो चतुर्थांशमा हुन्छ र माथिबाटको दृश्य अगाडिको दृश्यको तल राखिन्छ। नेपाल र भारतले पहिलो-कोण प्रक्षेपण प्रयोग गर्छन्।

question: In third-angle projection, the top view is placed:
options: To the right of the front view
explanation: In third-angle projection the view from above is placed above the front view; the USA and Canada use third-angle projection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तेस्रो-कोण प्रक्षेपणमा माथिल्लो दृश्य कहाँ राखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: तेस्रो-कोण प्रक्षेपणमा माथिबाटको दृश्य अगाडिको दृश्यको माथि राखिन्छ; अमेरिका र क्यानडाले तेस्रो-कोण प्रक्षेपण प्रयोग गर्छन्।

question: Nepal and India follow which angle of projection as standard?
explanation: As per IS (SP 46), India and Nepal use first-angle projection as the standard.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल र भारतले मानकका रूपमा कुन कोणको प्रक्षेपण पछ्याउँछन्?
explanation_ne: IS (SP ४६) अनुसार भारत र नेपालले पहिलो-कोण प्रक्षेपणलाई मानक मान्छन्।

question: The front view of an object shows its:
explanation: Front view: length (horizontal) × height (vertical); top view: length × width; side view: width × height.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वस्तुको अगाडिको दृश्यले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: अगाडिको दृश्य: लम्बाइ (तेर्सो) × उचाइ (ठाडो); माथिल्लो दृश्य: लम्बाइ × चौडाइ; छेउको दृश्य: चौडाइ × उचाइ।

question: The top view of an object shows its:
explanation: Top view (plan): length × width; front view: length × height; side view: width × height.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वस्तुको माथिल्लो दृश्यले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: माथिल्लो दृश्य (योजना): लम्बाइ × चौडाइ; अगाडिको दृश्य: लम्बाइ × उचाइ; छेउको दृश्य: चौडाइ × उचाइ।

question: In isometric projection, the three axes are at what angle to each other?
explanation: In isometric projection the three axes are 120° apart; the receding axes make 30° with the horizontal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक प्रक्षेपणमा तीन अक्ष एकअर्कासँग कति कोणमा हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक प्रक्षेपणमा तीन अक्ष १२०° टाढा हुन्छन्; पछाडि जाने अक्षले तेर्सोसँग ३०° बनाउँछन्।

question: In isometric projection, the true length is foreshortened by a factor of:
explanation: Isometric length = true length × √(2/3) ≈ 0.816; this is why an isometric scale is used.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक प्रक्षेपणमा वास्तविक लम्बाइ कति गुणनले छोटो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक लम्बाइ = वास्तविक लम्बाइ × √(2/3) ≈ ०.८१६; त्यसैले आइसोमेट्रिक स्केल प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: In an isometric drawing, a circle appears as:
explanation: A circle in isometric projection becomes an ellipse, with its major axis perpendicular to the axis of the cylinder.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक ड्रइङमा वृत्त कस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक प्रक्षेपणमा वृत्त अण्डाकार हुन्छ, जसको प्रमुख अक्ष बेलनको अक्षसँग लम्ब हुन्छ।

question: In oblique projection, the face parallel to the plane of projection is shown in:
explanation: In oblique projection the front face is true shape; the receding edges are drawn at an angle (usually 45°) and foreshortened.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तिरछा (oblique) प्रक्षेपणमा प्रक्षेपण तलसँग समानान्तर अनुहार कस्तो देखाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: तिरछा प्रक्षेपणमा अगाडिको अनुहार वास्तविक आकारमा हुन्छ; पछाडि जाने किनारा कोण (प्रायः ४५°) मा कोइन्छ र छोटो हुन्छ।

question: In cabinet oblique projection, the receding edges are drawn at:
explanation: Cabinet oblique uses half depth for receding lines; cavalier oblique uses full depth.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्याबिनेट तिरछा प्रक्षेपणमा पछाडि जाने किनारा कति लम्बाइमा कोइन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्याबिनेट तिरछामा पछाडि जाने रेखाका लागि आधा गहिराइ प्रयोग गरिन्छ; क्याभेलियर तिरछामा पूर्ण गहिराइ प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: The eccentricity of a parabola is:
explanation: Eccentricity: circle = 0, ellipse < 1, parabola = 1, hyperbola > 1.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्याराबोलाको उत्केन्द्रता (eccentricity) कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: उत्केन्द्रता: वृत्त = ०, अण्डाकार < १, प्याराबोला = १, हाइपरबोला > १।

question: The eccentricity of an ellipse is:
explanation: Ellipse eccentricity is between 0 and 1; a circle (eccentricity 0) is a special ellipse.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अण्डाकारको उत्केन्द्रता कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अण्डाकारको उत्केन्द्रता ० र १ बीच हुन्छ; वृत्त (उत्केन्द्रता ०) विशेष अण्डाकार हो।

question: The eccentricity of a hyperbola is:
explanation: Hyperbola eccentricity is greater than 1; it has two branches.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हाइपरबोलाको उत्केन्द्रता कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: हाइपरबोलाको उत्केन्द्रता १ भन्दा बढी हुन्छ; यसका दुई शाखा हुन्छन्।

question: An ellipse is defined as the locus of a point such that the sum of its distances from two fixed points is:
explanation: An ellipse is the locus of points where the sum of distances to the two foci is constant (equal to the major axis).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अण्डाकार भनेको बिन्दुको स्थान हो जसमा दुई स्थिर बिन्दुबाट दूरीको योग कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अण्डाकार बिन्दुहरूको स्थान हो जहाँ दुई फोकसबाट दूरीको योग स्थिर हुन्छ (प्रमुख अक्ष बराबर)।

question: The curve traced by a point on the circumference of a circle rolling on a straight line is a:
explanation: A cycloid is traced by a point on a rolling circle; an involute is traced by unwinding a string from a circle.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिधा रेखामा गुड्ने वृत्तको परिधिमा रहेको बिन्दुले बनाउने वक्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: साइक्लोइड गुड्ने वृत्तको बिन्दुले बनाउँछ; इन्भोल्युट वृत्तबाट डोरी खोल्दा बन्छ।

question: The involute curve is used for the profile of:
explanation: Gear teeth are usually involute in profile because it gives constant velocity ratio during meshing.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्भोल्युट वक्र कुनको प्रोफाइलका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: गियरका दाँत प्रायः इन्भोल्युट प्रोफाइलका हुन्छन् किनकि यसले मेसिङमा स्थिर वेग अनुपात दिन्छ।

question: A helix is the curve traced by a point moving:
options: Around a cylinder at constant pitch (screw thread)
explanation: A helix is a 3D curve winding around a cylinder — the basis of screw threads and springs.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हेलिक्स भनेको बिन्दुले कस्तो चल्दा बनाउने वक्र हो?
explanation_ne: हेलिक्स बेलन वरिपरि घुम्ने त्रि-आयामिक वक्र हो — स्क्रु थ्रेड र स्प्रिङको आधार।

question: In dimensioning, the aligned system means dimensions are placed:
options: Parallel to the dimension line (read from the bottom or right)
explanation: In the aligned system, dimension text is aligned with the dimension line; in the unidirectional system all text is horizontal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मापनमा एलाइन्ड प्रणाली भनेको मापन कसरी राखिन्छ?
options_ne: मापन रेखासँग समानान्तर (तलबाट वा दायाँबाट पढिने)
explanation_ne: एलाइन्ड प्रणालीमा मापन पाठ मापन रेखासँग मिलेको हुन्छ; युनिडायरेक्सनल प्रणालीमा सबै पाठ तेर्सो हुन्छ।

question: A radius dimension is indicated by the letter:
explanation: Radius is prefixed with R (e.g. R20); diameter is prefixed with Ø (e.g. Ø20).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: त्रिज्या मापन कुन अक्षरले देखाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: त्रिज्या R ले देखाइन्छ (जस्तै R20); व्यास Ø ले देखाइन्छ (जस्तै Ø२०)।

question: A diameter dimension is indicated by the symbol:
explanation: Diameter is prefixed with Ø; square sections are marked with □.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: व्यास मापन कुन चिन्हले देखाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: व्यास Ø ले देखाइन्छ; वर्गाकार खण्ड □ ले चिन्ह लगाइन्छ।

question: The standard angle of an arrowhead in dimensioning is about:
explanation: A dimension arrowhead is a filled triangle about 3 mm long with an included angle of about 15–20°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मापनमा तीरको टाउकोको मानक कोण लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मापन तीरको टाउको भरिएको त्रिभुज हो, लगभग ३ मिमि लामो र समावेश कोण लगभग १५–२०° हुन्छ।

question: A clearance fit is one in which the hole is:
explanation: Clearance fit: hole > shaft, so parts move freely; interference fit: shaft > hole; transition fit: may be either.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्लियरेन्स फिट भनेको कस्तो हो जसमा प्वाल:
explanation_ne: क्लियरेन्स फिट: प्वाल > शाफ्ट, त्यसैले भाग स्वतन्त्र रूपमा चल्छन्; इन्टरफेरेन्स फिट: शाफ्ट > प्वाल; ट्रान्जिसन फिट: दुवै हुन सक्छ।

question: An interference fit is one in which the shaft is:
explanation: Interference fit needs force or heating/cooling to assemble (e.g. press fit, shrink fit).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्टरफेरेन्स फिट भनेको कस्तो हो जसमा शाफ्ट:
explanation_ne: इन्टरफेरेन्स फिट जोड्न बल वा तताउने/चिस्याउने चाहिन्छ (जस्तै प्रेस फिट, श्रिङ्क फिट)।

question: In the hole-basis system, the fundamental deviation of the hole is:
explanation: In the hole-basis system the hole is kept constant (H, lower deviation zero) and the shaft size is varied to get the fit.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: होल-बेसिस प्रणालीमा प्वालको आधारभूत विचलन कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: होल-बेसिस प्रणालीमा प्वाल स्थिर राखिन्छ (H, तल्लो विचलन शून्य) र फिट पाउन शाफ्टको आकार बदलिन्छ।

question: The module of a gear is defined as:
options: Pitch diameter divided by number of teeth
Number of teeth divided by pitch diameter
explanation: Module m = D/T (pitch diameter / teeth); it is the basic size parameter of a gear.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गियरको मोड्युल भनेको के हो?
options_ne: पिच व्यासलाई दाँत संख्याले भाग गरेर
दाँत संख्यालाई पिच व्यासले भाग गरेर
explanation_ne: मोड्युल m = D/T (पिच व्यास / दाँत); यो गियरको आधारभूत आकार मापदण्ड हो।

question: If a gear has pitch diameter 120 mm and 30 teeth, its module is:
explanation: Module = 120 / 30 = 4 mm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गियरको पिच व्यास १२० मिमि र दाँत ३० भए मोड्युल कति हुन्छ?

question: The standard profile angle of a metric screw thread is:
explanation: Metric (ISO) threads have a 60° V-profile; Whitworth threads have 55°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मेट्रिक स्क्रु थ्रेडको मानक प्रोफाइल कोण कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मेट्रिक (ISO) थ्रेडको ६०° V-प्रोफाइल हुन्छ; ह्विटवर्थ थ्रेडको ५५° हुन्छ।

question: A full sectional view is obtained by cutting the object with a plane passing:
explanation: A full section cuts the whole object; a half section cuts only one quarter (one half of the view is sectioned).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पूर्ण खण्ड दृश्य वस्तुलाई कुन तलले काटेर प्राप्त गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: पूर्ण खण्डले पूरै वस्तु काट्छ; आधा खण्डले एक चौथाइ मात्र काट्छ (दृश्यको आधा भाग मात्र खण्ड हुन्छ)।

question: In a half-sectional view, how much of the object is shown in section?
options: One quarter is removed (half the view is sectioned)
explanation: Half section: one quarter is cut away; one half of the view shows the section, the other half shows the outside.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आधा-खण्ड दृश्यमा वस्तुको कति भाग खण्डमा देखाइन्छ?
options_ne: एक चौथाइ हटाइन्छ (दृश्यको आधा भाग खण्ड हुन्छ)
explanation_ne: आधा खण्ड: एक चौथाइ काटिन्छ; दृश्यको आधा भागले खण्ड देखाउँछ, अर्को आधाले बाहिर देखाउँछ।

question: The development (unfolding) of the lateral surface of a right circular cone is:
explanation: The lateral surface of a cone unfolds into a circular sector of radius = slant height.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिधा वृत्तीय शंकुको पार्श्व सतहको विकास (खोलाइ) कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: शंकुको पार्श्व सतह वृत्तको खण्डमा खुल्छ जसको त्रिज्या = तिरछा उचाइ हुन्छ।

question: The development of the lateral surface of a right circular cylinder is:
explanation: The lateral surface of a cylinder unfolds into a rectangle of height = cylinder height and length = π × diameter.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिधा वृत्तीय बेलनको पार्श्व सतहको विकास कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बेलनको पार्श्व सतह आयतमा खुल्छ जसको उचाइ = बेलन उचाइ र लम्बाइ = π × व्यास हुन्छ।

question: A triangular prism has how many faces?
explanation: A triangular prism has 2 triangular bases and 3 rectangular lateral faces = 5 faces.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: त्रिभुजाकार प्रिज्मका कति अनुहार हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: त्रिभुजाकार प्रिज्ममा २ त्रिभुजाकार आधार र ३ आयताकार पार्श्व अनुहार हुन्छन् = ५ अनुहार।

question: A square pyramid has how many faces?
explanation: A square pyramid has 1 square base and 4 triangular faces = 5 faces.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वर्गाकार पिरामिडका कति अनुहार हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: वर्गाकार पिरामिडमा १ वर्ग आधार र ४ त्रिभुजाकार अनुहार हुन्छन् = ५ अनुहार।

question: A sphere in orthographic projection appears in all views as a:
explanation: A sphere projects as a circle of the same diameter in front, top and side views.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गोला अर्थोग्राफिक प्रक्षेपणमा सबै दृश्यमा कस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: गोला अगाडि, माथि र छेउका दृश्यमा उही व्यासको वृत्तका रूपमा देखिन्छ।

question: When a cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base, the section is a:
explanation: A plane parallel to the base cuts a circle; a plane parallel to the axis cuts a hyperbola; an inclined plane cuts an ellipse or parabola.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शंकुलाई आधारसँग समानान्तर तलले काट्दा खण्ड कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: आधारसँग समानान्तर तलले वृत्त काट्छ; अक्षसँग समानान्तर तलले हाइपरबोला काट्छ; तिरछा तलले अण्डाकार वा प्याराबोला काट्छ।

question: When a cone is cut by a plane parallel to its axis, the section is a:
explanation: A plane parallel to the cone's axis cuts a hyperbola; a plane parallel to a generator cuts a parabola.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शंकुलाई अक्षसँग समानान्तर तलले काट्दा खण्ड कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: शंकुको अक्षसँग समानान्तर तलले हाइपरबोला काट्छ; जनरेटरसँग समानान्तर तलले प्याराबोला काट्छ।

question: A line parallel to both the HP and the VP appears in true length in:
options: Both the front and top views
explanation: A line parallel to both planes is parallel to the reference line, so it shows true length in both principal views.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: HP र VP दुवैसँग समानान्तर रेखा वास्तविक लम्बाइमा कुन दृश्यमा देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: दुवै तलसँग समानान्तर रेखा सन्दर्भ रेखासँग समानान्तर हुन्छ, त्यसैले दुवै मुख्य दृश्यमा वास्तविक लम्बाइ देखाउँछ।

question: A line perpendicular to the HP appears in the top view as a:
explanation: A line perpendicular to a plane projects as a point on that plane.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: HP सँग लम्ब रेखा माथिल्लो दृश्यमा कस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: तलसँग लम्ब रेखा त्यो तलमा बिन्दुका रूपमा प्रक्षेपित हुन्छ।

question: The title block in a drawing is placed at the:
explanation: The title block (drawing number, title, scale, date) is placed at the bottom right of the sheet.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा टाइटल ब्लक कुन ठाउँमा राखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: टाइटल ब्लक (ड्रइङ नम्बर, शीर्षक, स्केल, मिति) सिटको तल्लो दायाँ भागमा राखिन्छ।

question: The standard left-hand margin (filing margin) of a drawing sheet is:
explanation: The filing (left) margin is 20 mm; other margins are 10 mm (minimum) for A2–A4 sheets.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङ सिटको मानक बायाँ किनारा (फाइलिङ मार्जिन) कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: फाइलिङ (बायाँ) मार्जिन २० मिमि हुन्छ; अन्य मार्जिन A2–A4 सिटका लागि १० मिमि (न्यूनतम) हुन्छ।

question: Single-stroke lettering in engineering drawing is usually inclined at:
explanation: Inclined single-stroke lettering leans at 75° from the horizontal; vertical lettering is upright.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ ड्रइङमा एकल-स्ट्रोक अक्षर प्रायः तेर्सोसँग कति कोणमा झुकेको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: झुकेको एकल-स्ट्रोक अक्षर तेर्सोबाट ७५° मा झुक्छ; ठाडो अक्षर सीधा हुन्छ।

question: The two set squares used in drawing are:
explanation: Standard set squares are 45° (isosceles) and 30°–60°; together with a T-square they draw all standard angles.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा प्रयोग हुने दुई सेट स्क्वायर कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: मानक सेट स्क्वायर ४५° (समद्विबाहु) र ३०°–६०° हुन्; T-स्क्वायरसँगै तिनले सबै मानक कोण कोर्छन्।

question: For construction lines in a drawing, the recommended pencil grade is:
explanation: Hard pencils (2H/H) give light thin construction lines; HB is used for outlines and lettering.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा निर्माण रेखाका लागि सिफारिस गरिएको पेन्सिल ग्रेड कुन हो?
explanation_ne: कडा पेन्सिल (2H/H) ले हल्का पातलो निर्माण रेखा दिन्छ; HB रूपरेखा र अक्षरका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The cutting-plane line is drawn as a:
options: Thick chain line (long dash–short dash) with arrows at the ends
explanation: The cutting plane is a thick long-dash–short-dash line with arrowheads showing the direction of sight.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: काट्ने-तल रेखा कस्तो कोइन्छ?
options_ne: बाक्लो चेन रेखा (लामो धर्सा–छोटो धर्सा) जसको छेउमा तीर हुन्छ
explanation_ne: काट्ने तल बाक्लो लामो-धर्सा–छोटो-धर्सा रेखा हो जसको तीरले हेर्ने दिशा देखाउँछ।

question: A revolved section is one in which the section is:
options: Drawn rotated 90° and superimposed on the view
explanation: A revolved section is drawn on the view itself, rotated 90° about its axis (e.g. for a shaft cross-section).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: घुमाइएको खण्ड भनेको कस्तो हो जसमा खण्ड:
explanation_ne: घुमाइएको खण्ड दृश्यमै आफ्नो अक्ष वरिपरि ९०° घुमाएर कोइन्छ (जस्तै शाफ्टको क्रस-सेक्सनका लागि)।

question: The ratio of the height of capital letters to lowercase letters in standard lettering is:
explanation: In standard lettering, capital height = 10 units and lowercase height = 7 units.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानक अक्षरमा ठूला अक्षर र साना अक्षरको उचाइ अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मानक अक्षरमा ठूलो अक्षरको उचाइ = १० एकाइ र सानो अक्षरको उचाइ = ७ एकाइ हुन्छ।

question: Geometric tolerance of flatness controls:
options: How flat a surface is (all points within two parallel planes)
explanation: Flatness is a form tolerance: the surface must lie between two parallel planes a stated distance apart.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: समतलताको ज्यामितीय सहनशीलताले के नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
options_ne: सतह कति समतल छ (सबै बिन्दु दुई समानान्तर तलभित्र)
explanation_ne: समतलता एक रूप सहनशीलता हो: सतह तोकिएको दूरीमा रहेका दुई समानान्तर तलबीच पर्नुपर्छ।

question: Perpendicularity is a tolerance of:
explanation: Perpendicularity controls that a feature is at 90° to a datum plane or axis.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लम्बता कुनको सहनशीलता हो?
explanation_ne: लम्बताले कुनै विशेषता डेटम तल वा अक्षसँग ९०° मा छ भन्ने नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

question: The symbol for surface roughness (Ra) is shown with a:
explanation: Surface texture is shown with the √ symbol and the Ra value in micrometres.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सतह खस्रोपन (Ra) को चिन्ह कुनले देखाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: सतह बनावट √ प्रतीक र Ra मान (माइक्रोमिटरमा) ले देखाइन्छ।

question: In AutoCAD, the command to draw a circle is:
explanation: CIRCLE draws a circle by centre and radius (or diameter); LINE draws straight segments.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: AutoCAD मा वृत्त कोर्न प्रयोग हुने कमान्ड कुन हो?
explanation_ne: CIRCLE ले केन्द्र र त्रिज्या (वा व्यास) बाट वृत्त कोर्छ; LINE ले सिधा खण्ड कोर्छ।

question: In AutoCAD, the TRIM command is used to:
options: Cut off parts of objects at a boundary
explanation: TRIM cuts objects at a cutting edge; EXTEND lengthens them to a boundary.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: AutoCAD मा TRIM कमान्ड कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: TRIM ले काट्ने किनारामा वस्तु काट्छ; EXTEND ले सीमासम्म लम्ब्याउँछ।

question: The minimum number of orthographic views needed to fully describe a simple object is usually:
explanation: Most objects are fully described by front + top (+ side) views; complex objects may need more.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: साधारण वस्तुलाई पूर्ण रूपमा वर्णन गर्न आवश्यक न्यूनतम अर्थोग्राफिक दृश्य संख्या प्रायः कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: धेरैजसो वस्तु अगाडि + माथि (+ छेउ) दृश्यले पूर्ण रूपमा वर्णन हुन्छन्; जटिल वस्तुलाई बढी चाहिन सक्छ।

question: A frustum of a cone is formed by cutting a cone with a plane:
options: Parallel to the base, removing the top
explanation: A frustum is the part of a cone (or pyramid) left after cutting off the top by a plane parallel to the base.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शंकुको फ्रस्टम कसरी बन्छ?
options_ne: आधारसँग समानान्तर तलले माथिल्लो भाग काट्दा
explanation_ne: फ्रस्टम शंकु (वा पिरामिड) को त्यो भाग हो जुन आधारसँग समानान्तर तलले माथिल्लो भाग काटेपछि बाँकी रहन्छ।

question: The horizontal trace (HT) of a plane is its intersection with the:
explanation: HT is where the plane meets the HP; VT is where it meets the VP.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलको तेर्सो ट्रेस (HT) भनेको के सँगको छेदन हो?
explanation_ne: HT भनेको तलले HP सँग भेट्ने ठाउँ हो; VT भनेको VP सँग भेट्ने ठाउँ हो।

question: A plane perpendicular to the HP and inclined to the VP appears in the top view as a:
explanation: A plane perpendicular to a projection plane appears as a line (edge view) on that plane.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: HP सँग लम्ब र VP सँग तिरछा तल माथिल्लो दृश्यमा कस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रक्षेपण तलसँग लम्ब तल त्यो तलमा रेखा (किनारा दृश्य) का रूपमा देखिन्छ।

question: The isometric scale is used to obtain:
explanation: The isometric scale converts true lengths to isometric lengths (×0.816) for drawing.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक स्केल कुन प्राप्त गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक स्केलले वास्तविक लम्बाइलाई आइसोमेट्रिक लम्बाइ (×०.८१६) मा बदल्छ।

question: Which projection shows the object as it appears to the eye, with convergence to vanishing points?
explanation: Perspective projection mimics human vision — parallel lines converge at vanishing points on the horizon.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन प्रक्षेपणले वस्तुलाई आँखाले देखेजस्तै देखाउँछ, लोप बिन्दुतिर अभिसरणसहित?
explanation_ne: परिप्रेक्ष्य प्रक्षेपणले मानव दृष्टिको नक्कल गर्छ — समानान्तर रेखा क्षितिजमा लोप बिन्दुमा अभिसरित हुन्छन्।

question: The line where the picture plane meets the ground in perspective drawing is the:
explanation: In perspective, the ground line is the base line and the horizon line is at the observer's eye level.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: परिप्रेक्ष्य ड्रइङमा तस्बिर तलले भुइँसँग भेट्ने रेखा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: परिप्रेक्ष्यमा भुइँ रेखा आधार रेखा हो र क्षितिज रेखा पर्यवेक्षकको आँखाको स्तरमा हुन्छ।

question: In a perspective drawing, parallel lines appear to meet at the:
explanation: Parallel lines in perspective converge at a vanishing point on the horizon line.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: परिप्रेक्ष्य ड्रइङमा समानान्तर रेखा कहाँ भेटिएजस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: परिप्रेक्ष्यमा समानान्तर रेखा क्षितिज रेखामा रहेको लोप बिन्दुमा अभिसरित हुन्छन्।

question: A detail drawing shows:
options: A single part with all dimensions for manufacture
explanation: Detail drawings give complete manufacturing information for one part; assembly drawings show how parts fit together.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विवरण (detail) ड्रइङले के देखाउँछ?
options_ne: एउटा भाग निर्माणका लागि सबै मापनसहित
explanation_ne: विवरण ड्रइङले एउटा भागका लागि पूर्ण निर्माण जानकारी दिन्छ; एसेम्बली ड्रइङले भागहरू कसरी जोडिन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ।

question: An assembly drawing shows:
explanation: Assembly drawings show parts in their assembled positions, with a parts list (bill of materials).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एसेम्बली ड्रइङले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: एसेम्बली ड्रइङले भागहरूलाई जोडिएको स्थितिमा देखाउँछ, भाग सूची (बिल अफ मटेरियल) सहित।

question: The vernier scale is used to measure:
options: Fractions of the smallest division of the main scale
explanation: A vernier scale reads small fractions (e.g. 0.1 mm or 0.02 mm) beyond the main scale's smallest division.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भर्नियर स्केल कुन नाप्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: मुख्य स्केलको सबैभन्दा सानो भागको अंश
explanation_ne: भर्नियर स्केलले मुख्य स्केलको सबैभन्दा सानो भागभन्दा साना अंश (जस्तै ०.१ मिमि वा ०.०२ मिमि) पढ्छ।

question: A 45° set square combined with a 30°–60° set square can draw an angle of:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ४५° सेट स्क्वायरलाई ३०°–६०° सेट स्क्वायरसँग जोड्दा कति कोण कोर्न सकिन्छ?

question: The angle between the two receding axes and the vertical axis in isometric projection is:
explanation: All three isometric axes are 120° apart; the vertical axis is vertical and the other two are 30° above the horizontal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइसोमेट्रिक प्रक्षेपणमा दुई पछाडि जाने अक्ष र ठाडो अक्षबीचको कोण कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: तीनै आइसोमेट्रिक अक्ष १२०° टाढा हुन्छन्; ठाडो अक्ष ठाडो हुन्छ र अन्य दुई तेर्सोभन्दा ३०° माथि हुन्छन्।

question: Which of the following is NOT a pictorial projection?
explanation: Pictorial projections (isometric, oblique, perspective) show 3D appearance; orthographic projection shows separate 2D views.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन चित्रात्मक प्रक्षेपण होइन?
explanation_ne: चित्रात्मक प्रक्षेपण (आइसोमेट्रिक, तिरछा, परिप्रेक्ष्य) ले त्रि-आयामिक रूप देखाउँछ; अर्थोग्राफिक प्रक्षेपणले छुट्टा 2D दृश्य देखाउँछ।

question: The symbol for first-angle projection shows:
options: A frustum of a cone with the circle on the left of the trapezium
A frustum with the circle on the right
explanation: The first-angle symbol is a truncated cone: the circular view is on the left and the trapezium on the right (opposite in third-angle).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पहिलो-कोण प्रक्षेपणको प्रतीकले के देखाउँछ?
options_ne: शंकुको फ्रस्टम जसमा वृत्त ट्रापेजियमको बायाँ हुन्छ
explanation_ne: पहिलो-कोण प्रतीक काटिएको शंकु हो: वृत्ताकार दृश्य बायाँ र ट्रापेजियम दायाँ हुन्छ (तेस्रो-कोणमा उल्टो)।

question: The atomic number of an element is equal to the number of:
explanation: Atomic number Z = number of protons; mass number A = protons + neutrons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तत्त्वको परमाणु संख्या के को संख्यासँग बराबर हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: परमाणु संख्या Z = प्रोटोनको संख्या; द्रव्यमान संख्या A = प्रोटोन + न्युट्रोन।

question: The maximum number of electrons in the n = 3 shell is:
explanation: Maximum electrons in a shell = 2n²; for n = 3, 2×9 = 18.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: n = ३ खोलमा अधिकतम इलेक्ट्रोन संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: खोलमा अधिकतम इलेक्ट्रोन = 2n²; n = ३ भए २×९ = १८।

question: The maximum number of electrons in the n = 4 shell is:
explanation: Maximum electrons = 2n² = 2×16 = 32 for n = 4.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: n = ४ खोलमा अधिकतम इलेक्ट्रोन संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अधिकतम इलेक्ट्रोन = 2n² = २×१६ = ३२, n = ४ भए।

question: Which quantum number determines the shape of an orbital?
explanation: n gives size/energy, l gives shape (s, p, d, f), m gives orientation, s gives spin.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन क्वान्टम संख्याले कक्षाको आकार निर्धारण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: n ले आकार/ऊर्जा, l ले आकृति (s, p, d, f), m ले अभिविन्यास र s ले स्पिन दिन्छ।

question: The d-subshell can hold a maximum of how many electrons?
explanation: Subshell capacities: s = 2, p = 6, d = 10, f = 14.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: d-उपखोलमा अधिकतम कति इलेक्ट्रोन अटाउँछन्?
explanation_ne: उपखोल क्षमता: s = २, p = ६, d = १०, f = १४।

question: The f-subshell can hold a maximum of how many electrons?
explanation: Subshell capacities: s = 2, p = 6, d = 10, f = 14.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: f-उपखोलमा अधिकतम कति इलेक्ट्रोन अटाउँछन्?
explanation_ne: उपखोल क्षमता: s = २, p = ६, d = १०, f = १४।

question: The electronic configuration of iron (Fe, Z = 26) is:
explanation: Fe (Z = 26): 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁶ 4s² = [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s².
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फलाम (Fe, Z = २६) को इलेक्ट्रोनिक विन्यास कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Fe (Z = २६): 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁶ 4s² = [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s²।

question: Chromium (Cr, Z = 24) has the exceptional configuration:
explanation: Cr is [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹ (not 3d⁴ 4s²) because a half-filled d-subshell is extra stable; copper is [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्रोमियम (Cr, Z = २४) को अपवादात्मक विन्यास कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Cr [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s¹ हुन्छ (3d⁴ 4s² होइन) किनकि आधा भरिएको d-उपखोल अतिरिक्त स्थिर हुन्छ; तामा [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ हुन्छ।

question: Copper (Cu, Z = 29) has the exceptional configuration:
explanation: Cu is [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ because a fully-filled d-subshell is extra stable.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तामा (Cu, Z = २९) को अपवादात्मक विन्यास कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Cu [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ हुन्छ किनकि पूर्ण भरिएको d-उपखोल अतिरिक्त स्थिर हुन्छ।

question: Electronegativity in a period generally:
explanation: Across a period, nuclear charge rises and atomic size falls, so electronegativity increases left to right.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एउटा अवधिमा विद्युत्-ऋणात्मकता सामान्यतया कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अवधिभरि नाभिकीय आवेश बढ्छ र परमाणु आकार घट्छ, त्यसैले विद्युत्-ऋणात्मकता बायाँबाट दायाँ बढ्छ।

question: Atomic radius in a group generally:
explanation: Down a group, new shells are added, so atomic size increases despite rising nuclear charge.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एउटा समूहमा परमाणु त्रिज्या सामान्यतया कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: समूहमा तल जाँदा नयाँ खोल थपिन्छन्, त्यसैले नाभिकीय आवेश बढे पनि परमाणु आकार बढ्छ।

question: The most abundant element in the Earth's crust is:
explanation: Oxygen is about 46.6% of the crust by mass; silicon is next at about 27.7%.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पृथ्वीको भूपर्पटीमा सबैभन्दा प्रचुर तत्त्व कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अक्सिजन भूपर्पटीको द्रव्यमानको लगभग ४६.६% हो; सिलिकन अर्को लगभग २७.७% छ।

question: The most abundant metal in the Earth's crust is:
explanation: Aluminium (about 8.1%) is the most abundant metal in the crust; iron is next at about 5%.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पृथ्वीको भूपर्पटीमा सबैभन्दा प्रचुर धातु कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एल्युमिनियम (लगभग ८.१%) भूपर्पटीमा सबैभन्दा प्रचुर धातु हो; फलाम अर्को लगभग ५% छ।

question: Sodium chloride (NaCl) is held together by:
explanation: NaCl is an ionic compound: Na⁺ and Cl⁻ held by electrostatic attraction in a crystal lattice.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सोडियम क्लोराइड (NaCl) कुन बन्धनले जोडिएको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: NaCl आयनिक यौगिक हो: Na⁺ र Cl⁻ क्रिस्टल जालीमा विद्युत्स्थैतिक आकर्षणले जोडिएका हुन्छन्।

question: A hydrogen bond is strongest in:
explanation: Hydrogen bonding strength follows electronegativity: F > O > N, so HF has the strongest H-bonds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हाइड्रोजन बन्धन कुनमा सबैभन्दा बलियो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: हाइड्रोजन बन्धन शक्ति विद्युत्-ऋणात्मकताअनुसार हुन्छ: F > O > N, त्यसैले HF मा सबैभन्दा बलियो H-बन्धन हुन्छ।

question: The shape of a methane (CH₄) molecule is:
explanation: CH₄ has 4 bond pairs and no lone pairs, giving a tetrahedral shape with bond angles of 109.5°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मिथेन (CH₄) अणुको आकार कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: CH₄ मा ४ बन्धन जोडी र कुनै एकल जोडी छैन, त्यसैले १०९.५° बन्धन कोणसहित चतुष्फलकीय आकार हुन्छ।

question: The bond angle in methane (CH₄) is:
explanation: Tetrahedral geometry gives a bond angle of 109.5°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मिथेन (CH₄) मा बन्धन कोण कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: चतुष्फलकीय ज्यामितिले १०९.५° बन्धन कोण दिन्छ।

question: The shape of an ammonia (NH₃) molecule is:
explanation: NH₃ has 3 bond pairs and 1 lone pair, giving a trigonal pyramidal shape with bond angle about 107°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अमोनिया (NH₃) अणुको आकार कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: NH₃ मा ३ बन्धन जोडी र १ एकल जोडी हुन्छ, त्यसैले लगभग १०७° बन्धन कोणसहित त्रिकोणीय पिरामिडाकार हुन्छ।

question: The shape of a water (H₂O) molecule is:
explanation: H₂O has 2 bond pairs and 2 lone pairs, giving a bent shape with bond angle about 104.5°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पानी (H₂O) अणुको आकार कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: H₂O मा २ बन्धन जोडी र २ एकल जोडी हुन्छन्, त्यसैले लगभग १०४.५° बन्धन कोणसहित बाङ्गो आकार हुन्छ।

question: The pH of a neutral solution at 25°C is:
explanation: At 25°C, neutral pH = 7 (pH + pOH = 14); below 7 is acidic, above 7 is basic.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २५°से मा तटस्थ घोलको pH कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: २५°से मा तटस्थ pH = ७ हुन्छ (pH + pOH = १४); ७ भन्दा तल अम्लीय र माथि क्षारीय हुन्छ।

question: The pH of a 0.01 M HCl solution is:
explanation: HCl is a strong acid: [H⁺] = 0.01 M, so pH = −log(0.01) = 2.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ०.०१ M HCl घोलको pH कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: HCl बलियो अम्ल हो: [H⁺] = ०.०१ M, त्यसैले pH = −log(०.०१) = २।

question: The pH of a 0.001 M NaOH solution is:
explanation: NaOH is a strong base: [OH⁻] = 0.001 M, pOH = 3, so pH = 14 − 3 = 11.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ०.००१ M NaOH घोलको pH कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: NaOH बलियो क्षार हो: [OH⁻] = ०.००१ M, pOH = ३, त्यसैले pH = १४ − ३ = ११।

question: A buffer solution resists changes in pH because it contains:
options: A weak acid and its conjugate base (or a weak base and its conjugate acid)
explanation: Buffers (e.g. acetic acid + sodium acetate) neutralise small additions of acid or base.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बफर घोलले pH परिवर्तन रोक्छ किनकि यसमा के हुन्छ?
options_ne: कमजोर अम्ल र त्यसको संयुग्मी क्षार (वा कमजोर क्षार र त्यसको संयुग्मी अम्ल)
explanation_ne: बफर (जस्तै एसिटिक अम्ल + सोडियम एसिटेट) ले थोरै अम्ल वा क्षार थप्दा तटस्थ गर्छ।

question: One mole of any gas at STP occupies a volume of:
explanation: At STP (0°C, 1 atm), 1 mole of an ideal gas occupies 22.4 L.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: STP मा कुनै पनि ग्यासको एक मोलले कति आयतन ओगट्छ?
explanation_ne: STP (०°से, १ atm) मा आदर्श ग्यासको एक मोलले २२.४ लिटर ओगट्छ।

question: How many moles are in 44 g of CO₂? (C = 12, O = 16)
explanation: Molar mass of CO₂ = 12 + 2×16 = 44 g/mol, so 44 g = 1 mole.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: 44 ग्राम CO₂ मा कति मोल हुन्छ? (C = १२, O = १६)
explanation_ne: CO₂ को मोलर द्रव्यमान = १२ + २×१६ = ४४ g/mol, त्यसैले ४४ ग्राम = १ मोल।

question: How many moles are in 4 g of hydrogen gas (H₂)?
explanation: Molar mass of H₂ = 2 g/mol, so 4 g = 2 moles.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ४ ग्राम हाइड्रोजन ग्यास (H₂) मा कति मोल हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: H₂ को मोलर द्रव्यमान = २ g/mol, त्यसैले ४ ग्राम = २ मोल।

question: How many molecules are in 1 mole of water?
explanation: One mole of any substance contains Avogadro's number of particles (6.022 × 10²³).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १ मोल पानीमा कति अणु हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: कुनै पनि पदार्थको एक मोलमा एभोगाड्रो संख्याका कण (६.०२२ × १०²³) हुन्छन्।

question: The molar mass of sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सल्फ्युरिक अम्ल (H₂SO₄) को मोलर द्रव्यमान कति हुन्छ?

question: At constant pressure, if the absolute temperature of a gas doubles, its volume:
explanation: Charles's law: V ∝ T at constant pressure, so doubling T doubles V.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्थिर दबाबमा ग्यासको निरपेक्ष तापक्रम दोब्बर भए आयतन के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: चार्ल्स नियम: स्थिर दबाबमा V ∝ T, त्यसैले T दोब्बर भए V दोब्बर हुन्छ।

question: The value of the universal gas constant R is approximately:
explanation: R = 8.314 J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹ (or 0.0821 L·atm·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विश्वव्यापी ग्यास स्थिरांक R को मान लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: R = ८.३१४ J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹ (वा ०.०८२१ L·atm·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹)।

question: According to Le Chatelier's principle, increasing pressure on N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ shifts equilibrium to the:
explanation: The reaction has 4 moles of gas on the left and 2 on the right, so higher pressure favours the side with fewer moles (right).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ले शाटेलियर सिद्धान्तअनुसार N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ मा दबाब बढाउँदा साम्य कतातिर सर्छ?
explanation_ne: अभिक्रियामा बायाँ ४ मोल ग्यास र दायाँ २ मोल छ, त्यसैले उच्च दबाबले कम मोल भएको पक्ष (दायाँ) लाई समर्थन गर्छ।

question: The Haber process for ammonia uses a catalyst of:
explanation: The Haber process (N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃) uses an iron catalyst at about 450°C and 200 atm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अमोनियाका लागि हेबर प्रक्रियामा कुन उत्प्रेरक प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: हेबर प्रक्रिया (N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃) मा लगभग ४५०°से र २०० atm मा फलाम उत्प्रेरक प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: The Contact process for sulphuric acid uses a catalyst of:
explanation: The Contact process oxidises SO₂ to SO₃ over a V₂O₅ catalyst at about 450°C.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सल्फ्युरिक अम्लका लागि कन्ट्याक्ट प्रक्रियामा कुन उत्प्रेरक प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: कन्ट्याक्ट प्रक्रियाले लगभग ४५०°से मा V₂O₅ उत्प्रेरकमाथि SO₂ लाई SO₃ मा अक्सीकरण गर्छ।

question: In electrolysis, oxidation occurs at the:
explanation: Anode = oxidation (loss of electrons); cathode = reduction (gain of electrons).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विद्युत्-अपघटनमा अक्सीकरण कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: एनोड = अक्सीकरण (इलेक्ट्रोन गुमाउने); क्याथोड = अपचयन (इलेक्ट्रोन लिने)।

question: In a galvanic (voltaic) cell, the anode is:
explanation: In a galvanic cell the anode is negative (oxidation) and the cathode is positive; in electrolysis the anode is positive.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्याल्भेनिक (भोल्टाइक) सेलमा एनोड कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्याल्भेनिक सेलमा एनोड ऋणात्मक (अक्सीकरण) र क्याथोड धनात्मक हुन्छ; विद्युत्-अपघटनमा एनोड धनात्मक हुन्छ।

question: The standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) is assigned a potential of:
explanation: All standard electrode potentials are measured relative to the SHE, defined as 0.00 V.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानक हाइड्रोजन इलेक्ट्रोड (SHE) को विभव कति तोकिएको छ?
explanation_ne: सबै मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव SHE सापेक्ष नापिन्छ, जसलाई ०.०० V परिभाषित गरिएको छ।

question: Rusting of iron is an example of:
explanation: Rusting is electrochemical oxidation of iron in the presence of water and oxygen, forming hydrated iron(III) oxide.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फलाममा खिया लाग्नु कुनको उदाहरण हो?
explanation_ne: खिया लाग्नु पानी र अक्सिजनको उपस्थितिमा फलामको विद्युत्-रासायनिक अक्सीकरण हो, जसले जलयोजित फलाम(III) अक्साइड बनाउँछ।

question: The chemical formula of rust is approximately:
explanation: Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃·xH₂O.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खियाको रासायनिक सूत्र लगभग कुन हो?
explanation_ne: खिया जलयोजित फलाम(III) अक्साइड, Fe₂O₃·xH₂O हो।

question: The functional group −OH in an organic compound indicates a/an:
explanation: −OH = alcohol; −CHO = aldehyde; −CO− = ketone; −COOH = carboxylic acid.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जैविक यौगिकमा कार्यात्मक समूह −OH ले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: −OH = अल्कोहल; −CHO = एल्डिहाइड; −CO− = किटोन; −COOH = कार्बोक्सिलिक अम्ल।

question: The functional group −COOH indicates a:
explanation: −COOH is the carboxyl group of carboxylic acids (e.g. acetic acid, CH₃COOH).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कार्यात्मक समूह −COOH ले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: −COOH कार्बोक्सिलिक अम्लको कार्बोक्सिल समूह हो (जस्तै एसिटिक अम्ल, CH₃COOH)।

question: The IUPAC name of CH₃COOH is:
explanation: CH₃COOH has 2 carbons: ethanoic acid (common name acetic acid).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: CH₃COOH को IUPAC नाम के हो?
explanation_ne: CH₃COOH मा २ कार्बन छन्: इथानोइक अम्ल (सामान्य नाम एसिटिक अम्ल)।

question: The IUPAC name of HCHO is:
explanation: HCHO is the simplest aldehyde: methanal (common name formaldehyde).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: HCHO को IUPAC नाम के हो?
explanation_ne: HCHO सबैभन्दा सरल एल्डिहाइड हो: मेथानल (सामान्य नाम फर्माल्डिहाइड)।

question: Ethanol is produced by fermentation of glucose using:
explanation: Yeast ferments glucose to ethanol and CO₂: C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्लुकोजको किण्वनबाट इथानोल कुनले उत्पादन गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: यीस्टले ग्लुकोजलाई इथानोल र CO₂ मा किण्वन गर्छ: C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂।

question: The general formula of alkynes is:
explanation: Alkynes have one C≡C triple bond: CₙH₂ₙ₋₂.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एल्काइनको सामान्य सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एल्काइनमा एउटा C≡C तेब्बर बन्धन हुन्छ: CₙH₂ₙ₋₂।

question: Which of the following is an aromatic compound?
explanation: Benzene is aromatic (delocalised π-electrons, 4n+2 rule); alkanes are aliphatic.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन एरोमेटिक यौगिक हो?
explanation_ne: बेन्जिन एरोमेटिक हो (विस्थापित π-इलेक्ट्रोन, 4n+२ नियम); एल्केन एलिफ्याटिक हुन्।

question: The rate of a reaction generally increases when temperature rises because:
options: More molecules have energy above the activation energy
explanation: Higher temperature raises the fraction of molecules with energy ≥ activation energy, so the rate increases.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तापक्रम बढ्दा अभिक्रिया दर सामान्यतया किन बढ्छ?
options_ne: धेरै अणुमा सक्रियण ऊर्जाभन्दा बढी ऊर्जा हुन्छ
explanation_ne: उच्च तापक्रमले सक्रियण ऊर्जा ≥ भएका अणुको अंश बढाउँछ, त्यसैले दर बढ्छ।

question: The first law of thermodynamics states that energy:
options: Cannot be created or destroyed, only converted
explanation: First law: ΔU = q + w; energy is conserved.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: थर्मोडायनामिक्सको पहिलो नियमले ऊर्जा के भन्छ?
options_ne: सिर्जना वा नष्ट गर्न सकिँदैन, रूपान्तरण मात्र गर्न सकिन्छ
explanation_ne: पहिलो नियम: ΔU = q + w; ऊर्जा संरक्षित हुन्छ।

question: An exothermic reaction is one that:
explanation: Exothermic: ΔH < 0 (heat released); endothermic: ΔH > 0 (heat absorbed).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऊष्माक्षेपी (exothermic) अभिक्रिया भनेको कस्तो हो?
explanation_ne: ऊष्माक्षेपी: ΔH < ० (ताप छोडिन्छ); ऊष्माशोषी: ΔH > ० (ताप सोसिन्छ)।

question: An endothermic reaction is one that:
explanation: Endothermic: ΔH > 0; e.g. melting ice, photosynthesis, dissolving ammonium nitrate.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऊष्माशोषी (endothermic) अभिक्रिया भनेको कस्तो हो?
explanation_ne: ऊष्माशोषी: ΔH > ०; जस्तै बरफ पग्लनु, प्रकाश संश्लेषण, अमोनियम नाइट्रेट घुल्नु।

question: The enthalpy change (ΔH) of an exothermic reaction is:
explanation: Exothermic reactions release heat, so ΔH < 0; endothermic reactions have ΔH > 0.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऊष्माक्षेपी अभिक्रियाको एन्थाल्पी परिवर्तन (ΔH) कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ऊष्माक्षेपी अभिक्रियाले ताप छोड्छ, त्यसैले ΔH < ० हुन्छ; ऊष्माशोषीमा ΔH > ० हुन्छ।

question: Limestone (calcium carbonate) on heating gives:
explanation: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ on heating (thermal decomposition).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चुनढुंगा (क्याल्सियम कार्बोनेट) तताउँदा के दिन्छ?
explanation_ne: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ तताउँदा (तापीय विघटन)।

question: Slaked lime is:
explanation: Quicklime (CaO) + water → slaked lime Ca(OH)₂; its solution is lime water.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बुझाएको चुन के हो?
explanation_ne: काँचो चुन (CaO) + पानी → बुझाएको चुन Ca(OH)₂; यसको घोल चुन पानी हो।

question: Bleaching powder is chemically:
explanation: Bleaching powder (Ca(OCl)₂) is used as a disinfectant and bleaching agent; it releases chlorine with water.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ब्लीचिङ पाउडर रासायनिक रूपमा के हो?
explanation_ne: ब्लीचिङ पाउडर (Ca(OCl)₂) कीटाणुनाशक र ब्लीचिङ एजेन्टका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ; यसले पानीसँग क्लोरिन छोड्छ।

question: Washing soda is:
explanation: Washing soda (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O) is used for cleaning; baking soda is NaHCO₃.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: धुने सोडा के हो?
explanation_ne: धुने सोडा (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O) सफाइका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ; खाने सोडा NaHCO₃ हो।

question: Baking soda is:
explanation: Baking soda (NaHCO₃) releases CO₂ with acid or heat and is used in baking and as an antacid.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खाने सोडा के हो?
explanation_ne: खाने सोडा (NaHCO₃) ले अम्ल वा तापसँग CO₂ छोड्छ र बेकिङ तथा एन्टासिडका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Plaster of Paris is:
explanation: Plaster of Paris (CaSO₄·½H₂O) sets with water to gypsum and is used for casts and moulds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्लास्टर अफ पेरिस के हो?
explanation_ne: प्लास्टर अफ पेरिस (CaSO₄·½H₂O) पानीसँग जिप्सममा जम्छ र कास्ट तथा साँचाका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Gypsum is:
explanation: Gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) is the raw material for plaster of Paris.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जिप्सम के हो?
explanation_ne: जिप्सम (CaSO₄·2H₂O) प्लास्टर अफ पेरिसको कच्चा पदार्थ हो।

question: The hardest naturally occurring substance is:
explanation: Diamond (pure carbon, tetrahedral network) is the hardest natural material; graphite is soft and slippery.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्राकृतिक रूपमा हुने सबैभन्दा कडा पदार्थ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: हीरा (शुद्ध कार्बन, चतुष्फलकीय सञ्जाल) सबैभन्दा कडा प्राकृतिक पदार्थ हो; ग्रेफाइट नरम र चिप्लो हुन्छ।

question: Graphite conducts electricity because it has:
explanation: Graphite's layered structure has one delocalised electron per carbon, allowing conduction along the layers.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्रेफाइटले विद्युत् चलाउँछ किनकि यसमा के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्रेफाइटको तह संरचनामा प्रति कार्बन एउटा विस्थापित इलेक्ट्रोन हुन्छ, जसले तहसम्म चालन दिन्छ।

question: Diamond does not conduct electricity because:
options: All its valence electrons are used in covalent bonds
explanation: In diamond every carbon uses all 4 valence electrons in strong covalent bonds, leaving no free electrons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हीराले विद्युत् चलाउँदैन किनकि:
options_ne: यसका सबै भ्यालेन्स इलेक्ट्रोन सहसंयोजक बन्धनमा प्रयोग हुन्छन्
explanation_ne: हीरामा प्रत्येक कार्बनले सबै ४ भ्यालेन्स इलेक्ट्रोन बलिया सहसंयोजक बन्धनमा प्रयोग गर्छ, मुक्त इलेक्ट्रोन बाँकी हुँदैन।

question: Which of the following is a greenhouse gas?
explanation: Greenhouse gases (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, water vapour) trap infrared radiation; N₂, O₂ and Ar do not.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन हरितगृह ग्यास हो?
explanation_ne: हरितगृह ग्यास (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, पानीको बाफ) ले इन्फ्रारेड विकिरण समात्छन्; N₂, O₂ र Ar ले गर्दैनन्।

question: The main gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is:
explanation: CO₂ is the main long-lived greenhouse gas driving human-caused warming; water vapour is the largest overall contributor but its level is temperature-driven.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हरितगृह प्रभावका लागि मुख्य रूपमा जिम्मेवार ग्यास कुन हो?
explanation_ne: CO₂ मानव-कारण तापक्रम वृद्धिको मुख्य दीर्घकालीन हरितगृह ग्यास हो; पानीको बाफ समग्रमा सबैभन्दा ठूलो योगदानकर्ता हो तर त्यसको स्तर तापक्रम-चालित हुन्छ।

question: Acid rain is mainly caused by oxides of:
explanation: SO₂ and NOₓ dissolve in rain to form sulphuric and nitric acids, lowering rain pH below 5.6.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अम्लीय वर्षा मुख्यतः कुनका अक्साइडले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: SO₂ र NOₓ वर्षामा घुल्दा सल्फ्युरिक र नाइट्रिक अम्ल बन्छन्, वर्षाको pH ५.६ भन्दा तल झर्छ।

question: Normal rainwater is slightly acidic (pH about 5.6) because of dissolved:
explanation: CO₂ dissolves in rain to form weak carbonic acid, giving natural rain a pH of about 5.6.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य वर्षाको पानी अलि अम्लीय (pH लगभग ५.६) हुन्छ किनकि त्यसमा के घुलेको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: CO₂ वर्षामा घुल्दा कमजोर कार्बोनिक अम्ल बन्छ, प्राकृतिक वर्षाको pH लगभग ५.६ हुन्छ।

question: The ozone layer is found in the:
explanation: The ozone layer sits in the stratosphere (about 15–30 km up) and absorbs harmful UV radiation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ओजोन तह कुन तहमा पाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: ओजोन तह समताप मण्डलमा (लगभग १५–३० किमि माथि) हुन्छ र हानिकारक UV विकिरण सोस्छ।

question: Ozone depletion is mainly caused by:
explanation: CFCs release chlorine in the stratosphere, which catalytically destroys ozone.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ओजोन क्षय मुख्यतः कुनले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: CFC ले समताप मण्डलमा क्लोरिन छोड्छ, जसले उत्प्रेरक रूपमा ओजोन नष्ट गर्छ।

question: The chemical symbol for mercury is:
explanation: Hg comes from 'hydrargyrum' (Latin for liquid silver).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पारोको रासायनिक प्रतीक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Hg 'hydrargyrum' (तरल चाँदीका लागि ल्याटिन) बाट आएको हो।

question: The chemical symbol for tin is:
explanation: Sn comes from 'stannum' (Latin for tin); Si is silicon, Ti is titanium.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: टिनको रासायनिक प्रतीक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Sn 'stannum' (टिनका लागि ल्याटिन) बाट आएको हो; Si सिलिकन हो, Ti टाइटेनियम हो।

question: The chemical symbol for lead is:
explanation: Pb comes from 'plumbum' (Latin for lead); Pd is palladium.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिसाको रासायनिक प्रतीक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: Pb 'plumbum' (सिसाका लागि ल्याटिन) बाट आएको हो; Pd प्यालेडियम हो।

question: The process of a solid changing directly into a gas is called:
explanation: Sublimation: solid → gas directly (e.g. camphor, dry ice, iodine).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ठोस सोझै ग्यासमा बदलिने प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: उर्ध्वपातन: ठोस → ग्यास सोझै (जस्तै कपूर, सुख्खा बरफ, आयोडिन)।

question: Dry ice is solid:
explanation: Dry ice is frozen CO₂ (−78.5°C); it sublimes directly to gas.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुख्खा बरफ ठोस के हो?
explanation_ne: सुख्खा बरफ जमेको CO₂ (−७८.५°से) हो; यो सोझै ग्यासमा उर्ध्वपातन हुन्छ।

question: The latent heat of vaporisation of water is about:
explanation: Water's latent heat of vaporisation is about 2260 kJ/kg; latent heat of fusion is about 334 kJ/kg.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पानीको वाष्पीकरणको गुप्त ताप लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: पानीको वाष्पीकरणको गुप्त ताप लगभग २२६० kJ/kg हो; गलनको गुप्त ताप लगभग ३३४ kJ/kg हो।

question: The latent heat of fusion of ice is about:
explanation: Ice melts with a latent heat of fusion of about 334 kJ/kg at 0°C.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बरफको गलनको गुप्त ताप लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बरफ ०°से मा लगभग ३३४ kJ/kg गुप्त तापसँग पग्लन्छ।

question: Protein synthesis in the cell takes place in the:
explanation: Ribosomes translate mRNA into protein; lysosomes digest waste, chloroplasts do photosynthesis.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कोषमा प्रोटिन संश्लेषण कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: राइबोजोमले mRNA लाई प्रोटिनमा अनुवाद गर्छ; लाइसोजोमले फोहोर पचाउँछ, क्लोरोप्लास्टले प्रकाश संश्लेषण गर्छ।

question: Photosynthesis in plant cells takes place in the:
explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis (6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिरुवाका कोषमा प्रकाश संश्लेषण कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्लोरोप्लास्टमा क्लोरोफिल हुन्छ र प्रकाश संश्लेषण गर्छ (6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂)।

question: The number of chromosomes in a normal human somatic cell is:
explanation: Human somatic cells are diploid (2n = 46); gametes are haploid (n = 23).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य मानव शारीरिक कोषमा क्रोमोजोम संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मानव शारीरिक कोष द्विगुणित (2n = ४६) हुन्छन्; युग्मक एकगुणित (n = २३) हुन्छन्।

question: Down syndrome is caused by trisomy of chromosome:
explanation: Down syndrome is trisomy 21 (three copies of chromosome 21); trisomy 18 is Edwards syndrome, trisomy 13 is Patau syndrome.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डाउन सिन्ड्रोम कुन क्रोमोजोमको ट्राइसोमीले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: डाउन सिन्ड्रोम ट्राइसोमी २१ हो (क्रोमोजोम २१ का तीन प्रतिलिपि); ट्राइसोमी १८ एडवर्ड्स सिन्ड्रोम र ट्राइसोमी १३ पाटाउ सिन्ड्रोम हो।

question: The sex chromosomes in a human female are:
explanation: Females are XX, males are XY; the Y chromosome carries the SRY gene for male development.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव महिलामा लिंग क्रोमोजोम कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: महिला XX र पुरुष XY हुन्छन्; Y क्रोमोजोमले पुरुष विकासका लागि SRY जीन बोक्छ।

question: The sex chromosomes in a human male are:
explanation: Males are XY; the father determines the sex of the child (X-bearing or Y-bearing sperm).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव पुरुषमा लिंग क्रोमोजोम कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: पुरुष XY हुन्छन्; पिताले बच्चाको लिंग निर्धारण गर्छ (X-बोक्ने वा Y-बोक्ने शुक्रकीट)।

question: A cross between two heterozygous tall plants (Tt × Tt) produces tall offspring in the ratio:
explanation: Tt × Tt gives genotypes TT : Tt : tt = 1 : 2 : 1, so phenotypes are 3 tall : 1 dwarf.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दुई हेटेरोजाइगस अग्ला बिरुवा (Tt × Tt) बीचको क्रसले अग्ला सन्तान कुन अनुपातमा दिन्छ?
explanation_ne: Tt × Tt ले जीनोटाइप TT : Tt : tt = १ : २ : १ दिन्छ, त्यसैले फेनोटाइप ३ अग्ला : १ होचा हुन्छ।

question: In a monohybrid cross (Tt × Tt), the genotypic ratio is:
explanation: Genotypes TT : Tt : tt = 1 : 2 : 1; phenotypes are 3 : 1. The 9:3:3:1 ratio is for a dihybrid cross.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मोनोहाइब्रिड क्रस (Tt × Tt) मा जीनोटाइपिक अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: जीनोटाइप TT : Tt : tt = १ : २ : १ हुन्छ; फेनोटाइप ३ : १ हुन्छ। ९:३:३:१ अनुपात डाइहाइब्रिड क्रसका लागि हो।

question: In a dihybrid cross (YyRr × YyRr), the phenotypic ratio is:
explanation: Mendel's dihybrid cross gives 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 (both dominant : one dominant : other dominant : both recessive).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डाइहाइब्रिड क्रस (YyRr × YyRr) मा फेनोटाइपिक अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मेन्डेलको डाइहाइब्रिड क्रसले ९ : ३ : ३ : १ दिन्छ (दुवै प्रभावी : एउटा प्रभावी : अर्को प्रभावी : दुवै अप्रभावी)।

question: Mendel's law of segregation states that:
options: The two alleles of a gene separate during gamete formation
explanation: During meiosis, the two alleles of each gene segregate into different gametes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मेन्डेलको पृथक्करण नियमले के भन्छ?
options_ne: जीनका दुई एलिल युग्मक निर्माणमा अलग हुन्छन्
explanation_ne: मियोसिसमा प्रत्येक जीनका दुई एलिल फरक युग्मकमा अलग हुन्छन्।

question: The 'father of genetics' is:
explanation: Gregor Mendel's pea-plant experiments (1865) founded genetics.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आनुवंशिकीका पिता को हुन्?
explanation_ne: ग्रेगर मेन्डेलका केराउ-बिरुवा प्रयोग (१८६५) ले आनुवंशिकी स्थापना गरे।

question: DNA has a double-helix structure, discovered by:
explanation: Watson and Crick described the DNA double helix in 1953, using Franklin's X-ray data.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA को दोहोरो-हेलिक्स संरचना कसले पत्ता लगाए?
explanation_ne: वाटसन र क्रिकले १९५३ मा फ्र्याङ्कलिनको एक्स-रे तथ्यांक प्रयोग गरी DNA दोहोरो हेलिक्स वर्णन गरे।

question: In DNA, adenine pairs with:
explanation: Base pairing: A–T (2 hydrogen bonds), G–C (3 hydrogen bonds); RNA uses uracil instead of thymine.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA मा एडेनिन कुनसँग जोडिन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्षार जोडी: A–T (२ हाइड्रोजन बन्धन), G–C (३ हाइड्रोजन बन्धन); RNA मा थाइमिनको सट्टा युरासिल हुन्छ।

question: In DNA, guanine pairs with:
explanation: G–C pairs have 3 hydrogen bonds; A–T pairs have 2.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA मा ग्वानिन कुनसँग जोडिन्छ?
explanation_ne: G–C जोडीमा ३ हाइड्रोजन बन्धन हुन्छन्; A–T जोडीमा २ हुन्छन्।

question: How many hydrogen bonds are there between guanine and cytosine?
explanation: G–C pairs have 3 hydrogen bonds; A–T pairs have 2.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्वानिन र साइटोसिनबीच कति हाइड्रोजन बन्धन हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: G–C जोडीमा ३ हाइड्रोजन बन्धन हुन्छन्; A–T जोडीमा २ हुन्छन्।

question: RNA differs from DNA in that RNA contains:
options: Uracil instead of thymine, and ribose instead of deoxyribose
explanation: RNA is usually single-stranded, has ribose sugar and uracil; DNA is double-stranded with deoxyribose and thymine.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: RNA DNA भन्दा फरक छ किनकि RNA मा के हुन्छ?
options_ne: थाइमिनको सट्टा युरासिल र डिअक्सिराइबोजको सट्टा राइबोज
explanation_ne: RNA प्रायः एकल-स्ट्र्यान्डेड हुन्छ, राइबोज चिनी र युरासिल हुन्छ; DNA दोहोरो-स्ट्र्यान्डेड हुन्छ, डिअक्सिराइबोज र थाइमिन हुन्छ।

question: The process by which DNA makes an RNA copy is called:
explanation: Transcription copies DNA to mRNA; translation builds protein from mRNA; replication copies DNA.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DNA ले RNA प्रतिलिपि बनाउने प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: ट्रान्सक्रिप्सनले DNA बाट mRNA प्रतिलिपि गर्छ; ट्रान्सलेसनले mRNA बाट प्रोटिन बनाउँछ; रेप्लिकेसनले DNA प्रतिलिपि गर्छ।

question: The process by which mRNA is used to build a protein is called:
explanation: Translation occurs on ribosomes: codons in mRNA are read to assemble amino acids into protein.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: mRNA बाट प्रोटिन बनाउने प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: ट्रान्सलेसन राइबोजोममा हुन्छ: mRNA का कोडोन पढेर एमिनो अम्ललाई प्रोटिनमा जोडिन्छ।

question: A codon consists of how many nucleotide bases?
explanation: Each codon is 3 bases and codes for one amino acid (64 codons for 20 amino acids).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एउटा कोडोनमा कति न्युक्लियोटाइड क्षार हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक कोडोन ३ क्षारको हुन्छ र एउटा एमिनो अम्ल कोड गर्छ (२० एमिनो अम्लका लागि ६४ कोडोन)।

question: The start codon for protein synthesis is:
explanation: AUG codes for methionine and starts translation; UAA, UAG and UGA are stop codons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रोटिन संश्लेषणको सुरु कोडोन कुन हो?
explanation_ne: AUG ले मेथियोनिन कोड गर्छ र ट्रान्सलेसन सुरु गर्छ; UAA, UAG र UGA रोकिने कोडोन हुन्।

question: Which of the following is a stop codon?
explanation: Stop codons are UAA, UAG and UGA; AUG is the start codon.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन रोकिने कोडोन हो?
explanation_ne: रोकिने कोडोन UAA, UAG र UGA हुन्; AUG सुरु कोडोन हो।

question: Meiosis produces how many daughter cells?
explanation: Meiosis has two divisions producing 4 haploid cells (gametes); mitosis produces 2 diploid cells.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मियोसिसले कति छोरी कोष उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: मियोसिसमा दुई विभाजन हुन्छन् र ४ एकगुणित कोष (युग्मक) बन्छन्; माइटोसिसले २ द्विगुणित कोष बनाउँछ।

question: Mitosis produces how many daughter cells?
explanation: Mitosis produces 2 genetically identical diploid cells for growth and repair.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माइटोसिसले कति छोरी कोष उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: माइटोसिसले वृद्धि र मर्मतका लागि २ आनुवंशिक रूपमा उस्तै द्विगुणित कोष बनाउँछ।

question: Crossing over (exchange of genetic material) occurs during:
explanation: Crossing over between homologous chromosomes in prophase I creates genetic variation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्रसिङ ओभर (आनुवंशिक पदार्थको आदानप्रदान) कहिले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रोफेज I मा समजात क्रोमोजोमबीच क्रसिङ ओभरले आनुवंशिक विविधता सिर्जना गर्छ।

question: The human heart has how many chambers?
explanation: The heart has 2 atria and 2 ventricles; the left side pumps oxygenated blood to the body, the right side pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव मुटुमा कति कोठा हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: मुटुमा २ अलिन्द र २ निलय हुन्छन्; बायाँ पक्षले अक्सिजनयुक्त रगत शरीरमा पठाउँछ, दायाँ पक्षले अक्सिजनरहित रगत फोक्सोमा पठाउँछ।

question: The pulmonary artery carries:
options: Deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs
explanation: The pulmonary artery is the only artery carrying deoxygenated blood (right ventricle → lungs).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फुफ्फुसीय धमनीले के बोक्छ?
explanation_ne: फुफ्फुसीय धमनी अक्सिजनरहित रगत बोक्ने एक मात्र धमनी हो (दायाँ निलय → फोक्सो)।

question: The pulmonary vein carries:
options: Oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart
explanation: Pulmonary veins are the only veins carrying oxygenated blood (lungs → left atrium).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फुफ्फुसीय शिराले के बोक्छ?
explanation_ne: फुफ्फुसीय शिरा अक्सिजनयुक्त रगत बोक्ने एक मात्र शिरा हो (फोक्सो → बायाँ अलिन्द)।

question: Filtration of blood in the kidney occurs in the:
explanation: The glomerulus filters plasma; the tubules then reabsorb water and solutes and secrete wastes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मिर्गौलामा रगत छानिने काम कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्लोमेरुलसले प्लाज्मा छान्छ; नलीले पानी र घुलनशील पदार्थ पुनः सोस्छ र फोहोर निकाल्छ।

question: Insulin is produced by the:
options: Beta cells of the islets of Langerhans (pancreas)
explanation: Pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin, which lowers blood glucose; alpha cells secrete glucagon, which raises it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्सुलिन कुनले उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: प्यान्क्रियाजका बिटा कोषले इन्सुलिन स्राव गर्छन्, जसले रगत चिनी घटाउँछ; अल्फा कोषले ग्लुकागन स्राव गर्छन्, जसले बढाउँछ।

question: Glucagon is produced by the:
options: Alpha cells of the islets of Langerhans
explanation: Glucagon raises blood glucose by promoting glycogen breakdown in the liver.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्लुकागन कुनले उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्लुकागनले कलेजोमा ग्लाइकोजन विघटन बढाएर रगत चिनी बढाउँछ।

question: Bile is produced by the:
explanation: The liver makes bile (stored in the gall bladder); bile emulsifies fats for digestion.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पित्त कुनले उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: कलेजोले पित्त बनाउँछ (पित्त थैलीमा भण्डारण हुन्छ); पित्तले बोसो पचाउन इमल्सिफाइ गर्छ।

question: Bile is stored in the:
explanation: Bile made by the liver is concentrated and stored in the gall bladder, then released into the duodenum.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पित्त कुनमा भण्डारण हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: कलेजोले बनाएको पित्त पित्त थैलीमा गाढा भएर भण्डारण हुन्छ, त्यसपछि डुओडेनममा निस्कन्छ।

question: The enzyme pepsin in the stomach digests:
explanation: Pepsin (activated from pepsinogen by stomach acid) begins protein digestion in the stomach.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पेटमा पेप्सिन इन्जाइमले के पचाउँछ?
explanation_ne: पेप्सिन (पेटको अम्लले पेप्सिनोजेनबाट सक्रिय) ले पेटमा प्रोटिन पाचन सुरु गर्छ।

question: Salivary amylase in the mouth digests:
explanation: Salivary amylase (ptyalin) starts starch digestion in the mouth; pancreatic amylase continues it in the small intestine.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुखमा लार एमाइलेजले के पचाउँछ?
explanation_ne: लार एमाइलेज (टायलिन) ले मुखमा स्टार्च पाचन सुरु गर्छ; प्यान्क्रियाटिक एमाइलेजले सानो आन्द्रामा जारी राख्छ।

question: Most nutrient absorption takes place in the:
explanation: The small intestine, with villi and microvilli, absorbs most nutrients; the large intestine absorbs water and salts.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: धेरैजसो पोषक तत्व सोसिने काम कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: सानो आन्द्राले भिल्ली र माइक्रोभिल्लीसहित धेरैजसो पोषक तत्व सोस्छ; ठूलो आन्द्राले पानी र नुन सोस्छ।

question: Villi in the small intestine increase the surface area for:
explanation: Villi (and microvilli) hugely increase the absorptive surface of the small intestine.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सानो आन्द्राका भिल्लीले केका लागि सतह क्षेत्र बढाउँछन्?
explanation_ne: भिल्ली (र माइक्रोभिल्ली) ले सानो आन्द्राको सोस्ने सतह धेरै बढाउँछन्।

question: The normal number of bones in an adult human is:
explanation: Adults have 206 bones; babies are born with about 300, which fuse as they grow.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वयस्क मानवमा हड्डीको सामान्य संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: वयस्कमा २०६ हड्डी हुन्छन्; शिशु लगभग ३०० हड्डीसहित जन्मन्छन्, जुन बढ्दै जाँदा जोडिन्छन्।

question: The brain's largest part is the:
explanation: The cerebrum (two hemispheres) is the largest brain part, handling thought, memory and voluntary movement.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मस्तिष्कको सबैभन्दा ठूलो भाग कुन हो?
explanation_ne: सेरिब्रम (दुई गोलार्ध) मस्तिष्कको सबैभन्दा ठूलो भाग हो, सोच, स्मृति र स्वैच्छिक चलाइ सम्हाल्छ।

question: The cerebellum is mainly responsible for:
explanation: The cerebellum coordinates movement, balance and posture; the medulla controls breathing and heart rate.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सेरिबेलम मुख्यतः कुनका लागि जिम्मेवार छ?
explanation_ne: सेरिबेलमले चलाइ, सन्तुलन र आसन समन्वय गर्छ; मेडुलाले सास फेर्नु र मुटुको गति नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

question: The medulla oblongata controls:
explanation: The medulla (brainstem) controls vital involuntary functions: breathing, heart rate and blood pressure.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मेडुला अब्लोन्गाटाले के नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
options_ne: सास फेर्नु र मुटुको गति (अनैच्छिक कार्य)
explanation_ne: मेडुला (ब्रेनस्टेम) ले महत्वपूर्ण अनैच्छिक कार्य नियन्त्रण गर्छ: सास फेर्नु, मुटुको गति र रक्तचाप।

question: The reflex arc passes through the:
explanation: A reflex arc goes: receptor → sensory neuron → spinal cord → motor neuron → effector, bypassing the brain for speed.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रिफ्लेक्स आर्क कुनबाट जान्छ?
explanation_ne: रिफ्लेक्स आर्क: रिसेप्टर → संवेदी स्नायु → मेरुदण्ड → मोटर स्नायु → प्रभावक, गतिका लागि मस्तिष्क छोडेर।

question: The gap between two neurons is called the:
explanation: Nerve impulses cross the synapse via neurotransmitters (e.g. acetylcholine).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दुई न्युरोनबीचको खाली ठाउँलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: स्नायु आवेग सिन्याप्स पार गर्छ न्युरोट्रान्समिटर (जस्तै एसिटिलकोलिन) बाट।

question: Myelin sheath around a nerve fibre is made by:
options: Schwann cells (in the peripheral nervous system)
explanation: Schwann cells make myelin in peripheral nerves; oligodendrocytes make it in the central nervous system.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्नायु तन्तु वरिपरि माइलिन खोल कुनले बनाउँछ?
explanation_ne: स्वान कोषले परिधीय स्नायुमा माइलिन बनाउँछ; ओलिगोडेन्ड्रोसाइटले केन्द्रीय स्नायु प्रणालीमा बनाउँछ।

question: Haemoglobin is found in:
explanation: Haemoglobin in red cells binds oxygen in the lungs and releases it in tissues.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हेमोग्लोबिन कुनमा पाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: रातो कोषमा हेमोग्लोबिनले फोक्सोमा अक्सिजन बाँध्छ र तन्तुमा छोड्छ।

question: Platelets are mainly involved in:
explanation: Platelets plug damaged vessels and start the clotting cascade.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्लेटलेट मुख्यतः कुनमा संलग्न हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: प्लेटलेटले क्षतिग्रस्त रक्तनली बन्द गर्छन् र जमावट श्रृंखला सुरु गर्छन्।

question: Which white blood cell is most abundant?
explanation: Neutrophils are 50–70% of white cells (first responders to bacterial infection); lymphocytes are 20–40%.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन सेतो रक्त कोष सबैभन्दा प्रचुर हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: न्युट्रोफिल सेतो कोषको ५०–७०% हुन्छन् (जीवाणु संक्रमणमा पहिलो प्रतिक्रियाकर्ता); लिम्फोसाइट २०–४०% हुन्छन्।

question: Antibodies are produced by:
explanation: B cells differentiate into plasma cells that secrete antibodies; T cells handle cell-mediated immunity.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एन्टिबडी कुनले उत्पादन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: B कोष प्लाज्मा कोषमा बदलिएर एन्टिबडी स्राव गर्छन्; T कोषले कोष-मध्यस्थ प्रतिरक्षा सम्हाल्छन्।

question: The first line of defence against infection is the:
explanation: Intact skin and mucosa are physical barriers; white cells and antibodies are second/third lines.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: संक्रमणविरुद्ध प्रतिरक्षाको पहिलो रेखा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अक्षत छाला र श्लेष्म झिल्ली भौतिक बाधा हुन्; सेतो कोष र एन्टिबडी दोस्रो/तेस्रो रेखा हुन्।

question: Vaccination works by giving the body:
options: Memory of an antigen so it can respond faster next time
explanation: Vaccines train the immune system to remember a pathogen, so the next exposure is met with a fast, strong response.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खोपले शरीरलाई के दिएर काम गर्छ?
options_ne: एन्टिजेनको स्मृति ताकि अर्को पटक छिटो प्रतिक्रिया दिन सकियोस्
explanation_ne: खोपले प्रतिरक्षा प्रणालीलाई रोगजनक सम्झन तालिम दिन्छ, त्यसैले अर्को जोखिममा छिटो, बलियो प्रतिक्रिया हुन्छ।

question: Photosynthesis takes place mainly in the:
explanation: Leaves have the most chloroplasts; the equation is 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ in sunlight.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषण मुख्यतः कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: पातमा सबैभन्दा बढी क्लोरोप्लास्ट हुन्छन्; समीकरण 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ घाममा हो।

question: The raw materials for photosynthesis are:
explanation: Photosynthesis uses CO₂ + H₂O + light to make glucose and release oxygen.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणका कच्चा पदार्थ के हुन्?
explanation_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणले CO₂ + H₂O + प्रकाश प्रयोग गरी ग्लुकोज बनाउँछ र अक्सिजन छोड्छ।

question: The green pigment in leaves is:
explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light for photosynthesis and reflects green.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पातमा हरियो रंजक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: क्लोरोफिलले प्रकाश संश्लेषणका लागि रातो र नीलो प्रकाश सोस्छ र हरियो परावर्तन गर्छ।

question: Transpiration in plants is the loss of water through the:
explanation: Transpiration is water loss as vapour through stomata; it pulls water up from the roots.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिरुवामा वाष्पोत्सर्जन भनेको पातको के बाट पानी हराउनु हो?
explanation_ne: वाष्पोत्सर्जन स्टोमाटाबाट बाफका रूपमा पानी हराउनु हो; यसले जराबाट पानी माथि तान्छ।

question: Stomata are tiny pores on leaves that control:
explanation: Stomata open to let CO₂ in for photosynthesis and close to limit water loss.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्टोमाटा पातमा साना छिद्र हुन् जसले के नियन्त्रण गर्छन्?
explanation_ne: स्टोमाटा प्रकाश संश्लेषणका लागि CO₂ भित्र जान खोल्छन् र पानी हानि सीमित गर्न बन्द गर्छन्।

question: Xylem in plants transports:
options: Water and minerals from roots to leaves
explanation: Xylem carries water and minerals upward; phloem carries food (sugars) in both directions.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिरुवामा जाइलमले के ढुवानी गर्छ?
explanation_ne: जाइलमले पानी र खनिज माथि लैजान्छ; फ्लोएमले खाना (चिनी) दुवै दिशामा लैजान्छ।

question: Phloem in plants transports:
options: Food (sugars) from leaves to other parts
explanation: Phloem translocates sugars made in photosynthesis to growing and storage parts.
