source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिरुवामा फ्लोएमले के ढुवानी गर्छ?
explanation_ne: फ्लोएमले प्रकाश संश्लेषणबाट बनेको चिनी बढ्दो र भण्डारण भागमा पुर्‍याउँछ।

question: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria in root nodules of legumes are:
explanation: Rhizobium lives in legume root nodules and fixes atmospheric nitrogen into usable forms.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दलहनका जराका गाँठामा नाइट्रोजन स्थिर गर्ने जीवाणु कुन हो?
explanation_ne: राइजोबियम दलहनका जराका गाँठामा बस्छ र वायुमण्डलीय नाइट्रोजनलाई प्रयोगयोग्य रूप मा बदल्छ।

question: The nitrogen cycle's first step (nitrogen fixation) converts N₂ into:
explanation: Nitrogen fixation converts atmospheric N₂ to ammonia, which nitrifying bacteria then turn into nitrites and nitrates.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नाइट्रोजन चक्रको पहिलो चरण (नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण) ले N₂ लाई के मा बदल्छ?
explanation_ne: नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरणले वायुमण्डलीय N₂ लाई अमोनियामा बदल्छ, जसलाई नाइट्रीकरण जीवाणुले नाइट्राइट र नाइट्रेटमा बदल्छन्।

question: In a food chain, the primary producers are:
explanation: Producers (plants, algae) make food by photosynthesis; consumers eat them; decomposers break down dead matter.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खाद्य श्रृंखलामा प्राथमिक उत्पादक कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: उत्पादक (बिरुवा, शैवाल) ले प्रकाश संश्लेषणबाट खाना बनाउँछन्; उपभोक्ताले खान्छन्; विघटकले मरेको पदार्थ तोड्छन्।

question: The 10% law of energy flow in ecosystems states that only about 10% of energy:
options: Transfers from one trophic level to the next
explanation: At each trophic level about 90% of energy is lost (respiration, waste, heat) and only about 10% passes on.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पारिस्थितिक तन्त्रमा ऊर्जाको १०% नियमले के भन्छ?
options_ne: एउटा पोषण स्तरबाट अर्कोमा लगभग १०% ऊर्जा मात्र सर्छ
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक पोषण स्तरमा लगभग ९०% ऊर्जा हराउँछ (श्वास, फोहोर, ताप) र लगभग १०% मात्र अर्कोमा सर्छ।

question: The first antibiotic, penicillin, was discovered by:
explanation: Fleming discovered penicillin from Penicillium mould in 1928; Florey and Chain developed it as a drug.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पहिलो एन्टिबायोटिक पेनिसिलिन कसले पत्ता लगाए?
explanation_ne: फ्लेमिङले १९२८ मा पेनिसिलियम ढुसीबाट पेनिसिलिन पत्ता लगाए; फ्लोरे र चेनले यसलाई औषधिका रूपमा विकास गरे।

question: Bacteria reproduce mainly by:
explanation: Bacteria divide by binary fission — one cell splits into two identical cells.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जीवाणु मुख्यतः कुनबाट प्रजनन गर्छन्?
explanation_ne: जीवाणु द्विविभाजनबाट विभाजन गर्छन् — एउटा कोष दुई उस्तै कोषमा विभाजित हुन्छ।

question: Viruses differ from bacteria because viruses:
options: Cannot reproduce outside a host cell
explanation: Viruses are non-cellular and must infect a host cell to replicate; antibiotics do not work on them.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भाइरस जीवाणुभन्दा फरक छन् किनकि भाइरस:
explanation_ne: भाइरस अकोशिकीय हुन्छन् र प्रतिकृति गर्न पोषक कोष संक्रमित गर्नुपर्छ; एन्टिबायोटिकले तिनमा काम गर्दैन।

question: Which of the following is caused by a virus?
explanation: The common cold is viral (rhinoviruses); TB, cholera and typhoid are bacterial.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन भाइरसले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: साधारण रुघा भाइरल हो (राइनोभाइरस); TB, हैजा र टाइफाइड जीवाणुजन्य हुन्।

question: Which of the following is caused by a bacterium?
explanation: TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis; AIDS, measles and influenza are viral.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन जीवाणुले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: TB माइकोब्याक्टेरियम ट्युबरकुलोसिसले हुन्छ; एड्स, दादुरा र इन्फ्लुएन्जा भाइरल हुन्।

question: Malaria is caused by a:
explanation: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites (P. vivax and P. falciparum in Nepal) spread by Anopheles mosquitoes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मलेरिया कुनले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मलेरिया प्लाज्मोडियम परजीवी (नेपालमा P. भाइभ्याक्स र P. फाल्सिपारम) ले हुन्छ, एनोफिलिज लामखुट्टेबाट सर्छ।

question: The vector of dengue fever is the:
explanation: Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, chikungunya and Zika; it bites during the day.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डेंगु ज्वरोको भेक्टर कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एडिज इजिप्टीले डेंगु, चिकुनगुनिया र जिका सार्छ; यसले दिनमा टोक्छ।

question: The scientific name of the human species is:
explanation: Humans are Homo sapiens; the genus is Homo and the species is sapiens.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव प्रजातिको वैज्ञानिक नाम के हो?
explanation_ne: मानव Homo sapiens हुन्; वंश Homo र प्रजाति sapiens हो।

question: The scientific name of the Bengal tiger is:
explanation: Bengal tiger: Panthera tigris; lion: Panthera leo; leopard: Panthera pardus.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बंगाल बाघको वैज्ञानिक नाम के हो?
explanation_ne: बंगाल बाघ: Panthera tigris; सिंह: Panthera leo; चितुवा: Panthera pardus।

question: The scientific name of the one-horned rhinoceros is:
explanation: The greater one-horned rhinoceros of Nepal and India is Rhinoceros unicornis.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एकसिंगे गैंडाको वैज्ञानिक नाम के हो?
explanation_ne: नेपाल र भारतको ठूलो एकसिंगे गैंडा Rhinoceros unicornis हो।

question: The national animal of Nepal is the:
explanation: The cow is Nepal's national animal; the rhododendron (lali gurans) is the national flower and the danfe is the national bird.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय जनावर कुन हो?
explanation_ne: गाई नेपालको राष्ट्रिय जनावर हो; लालीगुराँस राष्ट्रिय फूल र डाँफे राष्ट्रिय चरा हो।

question: The national bird of Nepal is the:
explanation: The danfe (Lophophorus impejanus) is Nepal's national bird; the cow is the national animal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय चरा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: डाँफे (Lophophorus impejanus) नेपालको राष्ट्रिय चरा हो; गाई राष्ट्रिय जनावर हो।

question: The national flower of Nepal is the:
explanation: The rhododendron (Rhododendron arboreum, lali gurans) is Nepal's national flower.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल कुन हो?
explanation_ne: गुराँस (Rhododendron arboreum, लाली गुराँस) नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल हो।

question: The Golgi body is mainly involved in:
explanation: The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts and packages proteins into vesicles for secretion or delivery.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गोल्गी बडी मुख्यतः कुनमा संलग्न हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: गोल्गी उपकरणले प्रोटिनलाई परिमार्जन, वर्गीकरण र स्राव वा डेलिभरीका लागि भेसिकलमा प्याक गर्छ।

question: The endoplasmic reticulum with ribosomes attached is called:
explanation: Rough ER (with ribosomes) makes proteins; smooth ER (without ribosomes) makes lipids and detoxifies.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: राइबोजोम टाँसिएको एन्डोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलमलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: खस्रो ER (राइबोजोमसहित) ले प्रोटिन बनाउँछ; चिल्लो ER (राइबोजोमबिना) ले लिपिड बनाउँछ र विष हटाउँछ।

question: The smooth endoplasmic reticulum is mainly involved in:
explanation: Smooth ER synthesises lipids and steroids and detoxifies drugs and poisons.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चिल्लो एन्डोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम मुख्यतः कुनमा संलग्न हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: चिल्लो ER ले लिपिड र स्टेरोइड संश्लेषण गर्छ र औषधि तथा विष हटाउँछ।

question: Which of the following is a prokaryotic organism?
explanation: Bacteria are prokaryotes (no nucleus); amoeba, yeast and mushrooms are eukaryotes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन प्रोक्यारियोटिक जीव हो?
explanation_ne: जीवाणु प्रोक्यारियोट हुन् (नाभिक छैन); अमिबा, यीस्ट र च्याउ युक्यारियोट हुन्।

question: Amoeba moves with the help of:
explanation: Amoeba extends pseudopodia to move and engulf food; Paramecium uses cilia, Euglena uses a flagellum.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अमिबा के को सहायताले चल्छ?
explanation_ne: अमिबाले चल्न र खाना निल्न स्यूडोपोडिया फैलाउँछ; प्यारामिसियमले सिलिया र युग्लिनाले फ्लाजेलम प्रयोग गर्छ।

question: Paramecium moves with the help of:
explanation: Paramecium is covered in cilia that beat to move it through water.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्यारामिसियम के को सहायताले चल्छ?
explanation_ne: प्यारामिसियम सिलियाले ढाकिएको हुन्छ जुन पानीमा चल्न धड्कन्छ।

question: The SI unit of energy is the:
explanation: Energy/work is measured in joules; power (energy per second) is in watts.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऊर्जाको SI एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: ऊर्जा/कार्य जुलमा नापिन्छ; शक्ति (प्रतिसेकेन्ड ऊर्जा) वाटमा नापिन्छ।

question: Newton's third law of motion states that:
options: A body stays at rest unless forced
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction
explanation: Third law: action–reaction pairs act on different bodies with equal magnitude and opposite direction.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: न्युटनको तेस्रो गति नियमले के भन्छ?
options_ne: प्रत्येक क्रियाको बराबर र विपरीत प्रतिक्रिया हुन्छ
explanation_ne: तेस्रो नियम: क्रिया–प्रतिक्रिया जोडी फरक वस्तुमा बराबर परिमाण र विपरीत दिशामा कार्य गर्छन्।

question: Newton's second law of motion is expressed as:
explanation: Second law: force = mass × acceleration; also F = rate of change of momentum.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: न्युटनको दोस्रो गति नियम कसरी व्यक्त गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: दोस्रो नियम: बल = द्रव्यमान × त्वरण; F = संवेग परिवर्तन दर पनि हो।

question: If a force of 10 N acts on a mass of 2 kg, the acceleration is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २ किग्रा द्रव्यमानमा १० N बल लागे त्वरण कति हुन्छ?

question: The momentum of a 2 kg object moving at 3 m/s is:
explanation: Momentum p = mv = 2 × 3 = 6 kg·m/s.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ३ m/s गतिमा चलिरहेको २ किग्रा वस्तुको संवेग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: संवेग p = mv = २ × ३ = ६ kg·m/s।

question: Work is done when a force of 10 N moves an object 5 m in the direction of the force. The work is:
explanation: Work = force × distance = 10 × 5 = 50 J.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १० N बलले वस्तुलाई बलको दिशामा ५ मिटर सार्दा गरिएको कार्य कति हुन्छ?

question: The escape velocity from Earth is about:
explanation: Escape velocity from Earth is 11.2 km/s; the first cosmic (orbital) velocity is 7.9 km/s.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पृथ्वीबाट पलायन वेग लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: पृथ्वीबाट पलायन वेग ११.२ km/s हो; पहिलो ब्रह्माण्डीय (कक्षीय) वेग ७.९ km/s हो।

question: A geostationary satellite orbits Earth at a height of about:
explanation: Geostationary orbit is about 35,786 km above the equator, with a period of 24 hours.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भूस्थिर उपग्रह पृथ्वीको भूमध्यरेखाबाट लगभग कति उचाइमा परिक्रमा गर्छ?
explanation_ne: भूस्थिर कक्षा भूमध्यरेखाबाट लगभग ३५,७८६ किमि माथि हुन्छ, अवधि २४ घण्टा।

question: The time period of a simple pendulum depends on its:
explanation: T = 2π√(l/g); the period depends on length and g, not on mass or (for small angles) amplitude.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सरल लोलकको आवर्तकाल कुनमा निर्भर गर्छ?
explanation_ne: T = 2π√(l/g); आवर्तकाल लम्बाइ र g मा निर्भर गर्छ, द्रव्यमान वा (साना कोणमा) आयाममा होइन।

question: If the length of a simple pendulum is quadrupled, its time period:
explanation: T ∝ √l, so quadrupling l doubles T.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सरल लोलकको लम्बाइ चार गुणा भए आवर्तकाल के हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: T ∝ √l, त्यसैले l चार गुणा भए T दोब्बर हुन्छ।

question: The frequency of a wave is the:
options: Number of waves passing a point per second
explanation: Frequency f = 1/T (hertz); wavelength λ is the distance between crests; wave speed v = fλ.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तरंगको आवृत्ति भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: आवृत्ति f = 1/T (हर्ज); तरंगदैर्ध्य λ चुचुराबीचको दूरी हो; तरंग गति v = fλ।

question: The speed of sound in air at 20°C is about:
explanation: Sound travels about 343 m/s in air at 20°C, about 1500 m/s in water, and fastest in solids.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २०°से मा हवामा ध्वनिको गति लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ध्वनि २०°से मा हवामा लगभग ३४३ m/s, पानीमा लगभग १५०० m/s र ठोसमा सबैभन्दा छिटो चल्छ।

question: The speed of light in a vacuum is about:
explanation: c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s (299,792,458 m/s exactly); it is the cosmic speed limit.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शून्यमा प्रकाशको गति लगभग कति हुन्छ?

question: Ultrasonic waves have frequencies above:
explanation: Ultrasound is above 20 kHz (human hearing is 20 Hz–20 kHz); infrasound is below 20 Hz.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अल्ट्रासोनिक तरंगको आवृत्ति कति भन्दा माथि हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: अल्ट्रासाउन्ड २० kHz भन्दा माथि हुन्छ (मानव सुन्ने २० Hz–२० kHz हो); इन्फ्रासाउन्ड २० Hz भन्दा तल हुन्छ।

question: The audible range of human hearing is about:
explanation: Humans hear roughly 20 Hz–20 kHz; the range narrows with age.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानव सुन्ने दायरा लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मानवले लगभग २० Hz–२० kHz सुन्छ; उमेरसँगै दायरा साँघुरिन्छ।

question: If a current of 2 A flows through a 5 Ω resistor, the voltage across it is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ५ Ω प्रतिरोधबाट २ A धारा बग्दा त्यसमा भोल्टेज कति हुन्छ?

question: The power dissipated in a 10 Ω resistor carrying 2 A is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २ A धारा बोक्ने १० Ω प्रतिरोधमा खर्च हुने शक्ति कति हुन्छ?

question: In a series circuit, the current through each resistor is:
explanation: Series circuits have the same current everywhere; voltage divides across resistors.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: श्रृंखला परिपथमा प्रत्येक प्रतिरोधबाट बग्ने धारा कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: श्रृंखला परिपथमा सबै ठाउँमा धारा उस्तै हुन्छ; भोल्टेज प्रतिरोधमा विभाजित हुन्छ।

question: In a parallel circuit, the voltage across each resistor is:
explanation: Parallel branches share the same voltage; current divides inversely with resistance.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: समानान्तर परिपथमा प्रत्येक प्रतिरोधमा भोल्टेज कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: समानान्तर शाखाले उही भोल्टेज साझा गर्छन्; धारा प्रतिरोधको व्युत्क्रमानुपातमा विभाजित हुन्छ।

question: The SI unit of electric charge is the:
explanation: Charge is measured in coulombs; current (charge per second) is in amperes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विद्युतीय आवेशको SI एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: आवेश कुलम्बमा नापिन्छ; धारा (प्रतिसेकेन्ड आवेश) एम्पियरमा नापिन्छ।

question: The charge of one electron is approximately:
explanation: Electron charge e = −1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; proton charge is +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एउटा इलेक्ट्रोनको आवेश लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: इलेक्ट्रोन आवेश e = −1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; प्रोटोन आवेश +1.602 × 10⁻¹⁹ C हुन्छ।

question: A step-up transformer:
explanation: Step-up: more turns in secondary, so voltage rises and current falls (power is conserved, ignoring losses).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्टेप-अप ट्रान्सफर्मरले के गर्छ?
explanation_ne: स्टेप-अप: दोस्रो कुण्डलीमा बढी घुमाउ, त्यसैले भोल्टेज बढ्छ र धारा घट्छ (शक्ति संरक्षित हुन्छ, हानि बेवास्ता गर्दा)।

question: The turns ratio of a transformer is 1:10. If the primary voltage is 220 V, the secondary voltage is:
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ट्रान्सफर्मरको घुमाउ अनुपात १:१० छ। प्राथमिक भोल्टेज २२० V भए दोस्रो भोल्टेज कति हुन्छ?

question: Fleming's left-hand rule is used for:
options: The force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field (motors)
explanation: Fleming's left-hand rule (motor rule): thumb = force, first finger = field, second finger = current.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फ्लेमिङको बायाँ-हात नियम कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: चुम्बकीय क्षेत्रमा धारा बोक्ने चालकमा बल (मोटर)
explanation_ne: फ्लेमिङको बायाँ-हात नियम (मोटर नियम): औँला = बल, पहिलो औँला = क्षेत्र, दोस्रो औँला = धारा।

question: Fleming's right-hand rule is used for:
options: The direction of induced current in a generator
explanation: Fleming's right-hand rule (generator rule): thumb = motion, first finger = field, second finger = induced current.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फ्लेमिङको दायाँ-हात नियम कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: फ्लेमिङको दायाँ-हात नियम (जेनेरेटर नियम): औँला = गति, पहिलो औँला = क्षेत्र, दोस्रो औँला = प्रेरित धारा।

question: The SI unit of magnetic flux density (B) is the:
explanation: Magnetic flux density is measured in tesla; magnetic flux is in weber (1 T = 1 Wb/m²).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चुम्बकीय फ्लक्स घनत्व (B) को SI एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: चुम्बकीय फ्लक्स घनत्व टेस्लामा नापिन्छ; चुम्बकीय फ्लक्स वेबरमा नापिन्छ (१ T = १ Wb/m²)।

question: The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection. This is the law of:
explanation: Law of reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection, both measured from the normal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आपतन कोण बराबर परावर्तन कोण हुन्छ। यो कुनको नियम हो?
explanation_ne: परावर्तनको नियम: आपतन कोण = परावर्तन कोण, दुवै अभिलम्बबाट नापिन्छ।

question: Snell's law relates the angles of incidence and refraction through the:
options: Refractive indices of the two media
explanation: Snell's law: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्नेल नियमले आपतन र अपवर्तन कोणलाई के बाट सम्बन्धित गर्छ?
explanation_ne: स्नेल नियम: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂।

question: The refractive index of water is about:
explanation: Water n ≈ 1.33; glass n ≈ 1.5; diamond n ≈ 2.42; air n ≈ 1.00.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पानीको अपवर्तनांक लगभग कति हुन्छ?

question: The refractive index of diamond is about:
explanation: Diamond's very high refractive index (2.42) gives it its brilliance.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हीराको अपवर्तनांक लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: हीराको धेरै उच्च अपवर्तनांक (२.४२) ले यसलाई चमक दिन्छ।

question: Total internal reflection occurs when light travels from:
options: A denser to a rarer medium at an angle above the critical angle
A rarer to a denser medium
explanation: TIR needs light going from denser to rarer medium with incidence above the critical angle; it is used in optical fibres.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पूर्ण आन्तरिक परावर्तन कहिले हुन्छ?
options_ne: कुनै पनि माध्यममा कुनै पनि कोणमा
बाक्लोबाट पातलो माध्यममा क्रिटिकल कोणभन्दा माथि जाँदा
explanation_ne: TIR लाई बाक्लोबाट पातलो माध्यममा क्रिटिकल कोणभन्दा माथि आपतन चाहिन्छ; यो अप्टिकल फाइबरमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Optical fibres work on the principle of:
explanation: Light in an optical fibre reflects totally at the core–cladding boundary, so signals travel long distances with little loss.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अप्टिकल फाइबर कुन सिद्धान्तमा काम गर्छ?
explanation_ne: अप्टिकल फाइबरमा प्रकाश कोर–क्ल्याडिङ सीमामा पूर्ण रूपमा परावर्तित हुन्छ, त्यसैले संकेत कम हानिसहित लामो दूरी जान्छ।

question: A convex lens is also called a:
explanation: A convex lens converges parallel rays to a focus; a concave lens diverges them.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उत्तल लेन्सलाई अर्को के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: उत्तल लेन्सले समानान्तर किरणलाई फोकसमा अभिसरित गर्छ; अवतल लेन्सले छरपस्ट गर्छ।

question: A concave lens is also called a:
explanation: A concave lens diverges parallel rays as if from a virtual focus.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अवतल लेन्सलाई अर्को के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: अवतल लेन्सले समानान्तर किरणलाई आभासी फोकसबाट आएजस्तै छरपस्ट गर्छ।

question: The lens formula is:
explanation: Lens formula: 1/f = 1/v − 1/u (with sign convention); mirror formula is 1/f = 1/v + 1/u.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लेन्स सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: लेन्स सूत्र: 1/f = 1/v − 1/u (चिन्ह परिपाटीसहित); ऐना सूत्र 1/f = 1/v + 1/u हो।

question: The mirror formula is:
explanation: Mirror formula: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u; magnification m = −v/u for mirrors.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऐना सूत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: ऐना सूत्र: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u; ऐनाका लागि आवर्धन m = −v/u हो।

question: A convex mirror always forms an image that is:
explanation: Convex mirrors always give virtual, erect, smaller images — used as rear-view mirrors in vehicles.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उत्तल ऐनाले सधैं कस्तो प्रतिबिम्ब बनाउँछ?
explanation_ne: उत्तल ऐनाले सधैं आभासी, सीधा, सानो प्रतिबिम्ब दिन्छ — सवारी साधनमा पछाडि हेर्ने ऐनाका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: A concave mirror is used as a shaving mirror because it forms a:
options: Magnified, erect, virtual image when the object is close
explanation: When the object is inside the focal length, a concave mirror gives a magnified erect virtual image.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अवतल ऐना दाह्री काट्ने ऐनाका रूपमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ किनकि यसले के बनाउँछ?
options_ne: वस्तु नजिक हुँदा ठूलो, सीधा, आभासी प्रतिबिम्ब
explanation_ne: वस्तु फोकल लम्बाइभित्र हुँदा अवतल ऐनाले ठूलो सीधा आभासी प्रतिबिम्ब दिन्छ।

question: The focal length of a plane mirror is:
explanation: A plane mirror has infinite focal length (zero power); its image is virtual, erect and the same size, as far behind as the object is in front.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: समतल ऐनाको फोकल लम्बाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: समतल ऐनाको फोकल लम्बाइ अनन्त हुन्छ (शून्य शक्ति); यसको प्रतिबिम्ब आभासी, सीधा र उस्तै आकारको हुन्छ, वस्तु अगाडि जति छ प्रतिबिम्ब पछाडि त्यति हुन्छ।

question: Dispersion of white light through a prism produces:
explanation: A prism disperses white light into its seven colours because refractive index varies with wavelength.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रिज्मबाट सेतो प्रकाशको विक्षेपणले के बनाउँछ?
explanation_ne: प्रिज्मले सेतो प्रकाशलाई सात रंगमा विक्षेपित गर्छ किनकि अपवर्तनांक तरंगदैर्ध्यसँग बदलिन्छ।

question: In the visible spectrum, which colour has the longest wavelength?
explanation: Red has the longest wavelength (about 700 nm) and lowest frequency; violet has the shortest (about 400 nm).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दृश्य वर्णक्रममा कुन रंगको तरंगदैर्ध्य सबैभन्दा लामो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: रातोको तरंगदैर्ध्य सबैभन्दा लामो (लगभग ७०० nm) र आवृत्ति सबैभन्दा कम हुन्छ; बैजनीको सबैभन्दा छोटो (लगभग ४०० nm) हुन्छ।

question: In the visible spectrum, which colour has the shortest wavelength?
explanation: Violet has the shortest visible wavelength (about 400 nm); red has the longest (about 700 nm).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दृश्य वर्णक्रममा कुन रंगको तरंगदैर्ध्य सबैभन्दा छोटो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बैजनीको दृश्य तरंगदैर्ध्य सबैभन्दा छोटो (लगभग ४०० nm) हुन्छ; रातोको सबैभन्दा लामो (लगभग ७०० nm) हुन्छ।

question: The sky appears blue because of:
options: Scattering of sunlight by air molecules (Rayleigh scattering)
explanation: Short blue wavelengths are scattered much more than red by air molecules, so the sky looks blue.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आकाश नीलो देखिनुको कारण के हो?
options_ne: हवाका अणुले सूर्यको प्रकाश छर्नु (रेले स्क्याटरिङ)
explanation_ne: छोटो नीलो तरंगदैर्ध्य हवाका अणुले रातोभन्दा धेरै छर्छन्, त्यसैले आकाश नीलो देखिन्छ।

question: The sun appears red at sunset because:
options: Blue light is scattered away over the long path through the atmosphere
explanation: At sunset sunlight travels a long path, so blue is scattered away and the remaining red/orange light reaches our eyes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सूर्यास्तमा सूर्य रातो देखिनुको कारण के हो?
options_ne: लामो बाटोमा नीलो प्रकाश छरिएर जानु
explanation_ne: सूर्यास्तमा सूर्यको प्रकाश लामो बाटो यात्रा गर्छ, त्यसैले नीलो छरिएर जान्छ र बाँकी रातो/सुन्तला प्रकाश हाम्रा आँखामा पुग्छ।

question: In the photoelectric effect, increasing the intensity of light increases the:
options: Number of photoelectrons emitted (not their kinetic energy)
explanation: Intensity controls the number of photons (hence photoelectrons); frequency controls each electron's maximum kinetic energy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question_ne: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरणको रिट कसका लागि जारी गरिन्छ?
options_ne: गैरकानूनी रूपमा थुनिएको व्यक्तिलाई अदालतसमक्ष उपस्थित गराउन
explanation_ne: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरण ('शरीर उपस्थित गराऊ') ले गैरकानूनी थुनाविरुद्ध व्यक्तिगत स्वतन्त्रता रक्षा गर्छ।

question: Certiorari is a writ issued to:
options: Quash an order of a lower court or tribunal made without jurisdiction
Compel a public authority to act
explanation: Certiorari quashes decisions made without jurisdiction or in excess of jurisdiction.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उत्प्रेषणको रिट कसका लागि जारी गरिन्छ?
options_ne: क्षेत्राधिकारबिना गरिएको तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणको आदेश बदर गर्न
सार्वजनिक निकायलाई काम गर्न बाध्य पार्न
explanation_ne: उत्प्रेषणले क्षेत्राधिकारबिना वा क्षेत्राधिकारभन्दा बाहिर गरिएका निर्णय बदर गर्छ।

question: Mandamus is a writ issued to:
options: Compel a public authority to perform its legal duty
explanation: Mandamus ('we command') orders a public body to do what the law requires it to do.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: परमादेशको रिट कसका लागि जारी गरिन्छ?
options_ne: सार्वजनिक निकायलाई आफ्नो कानूनी कर्तव्य पूरा गर्न बाध्य पार्न
explanation_ne: परमादेश ('हामी आदेश दिन्छौं') ले सार्वजनिक निकायलाई कानूनले मागेको काम गर्न आदेश दिन्छ।

question: Prohibition is a writ issued to:
options: Prevent a lower court or tribunal from exceeding its jurisdiction
explanation: Prohibition stops a lower body from proceeding beyond its jurisdiction; certiorari quashes an order already made.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: निषेधाज्ञाको रिट कसका लागि जारी गरिन्छ?
options_ne: तल्लो अदालत वा न्यायाधिकरणलाई क्षेत्राधिकार नाघ्नबाट रोक्न
explanation_ne: निषेधाज्ञाले तल्लो निकायलाई क्षेत्राधिकारभन्दा बाहिर जानबाट रोक्छ; उत्प्रेषणले भइसकेको आदेश बदर गर्छ।

question: Quo warranto is a writ issued to:
options: Question a person's legal right to hold a public office
explanation: Quo warranto ('by what authority') asks by what authority a person holds a public office.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अधिकारपृच्छाको रिट कसका लागि जारी गरिन्छ?
options_ne: सार्वजनिक पद धारण गर्ने व्यक्तिको कानूनी अधिकार प्रश्न गर्न
explanation_ne: अधिकारपृच्छा ('कुन अधिकारले') ले व्यक्तिले कुन अधिकारले सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेको भनी सोध्छ।

question: Nepal Rastra Bank was established under which Act?
explanation: NRB was established under the Nepal Rastra Bank Act, 1955 (2012 BS); the current governing law is the Nepal Rastra Bank Act, 2058 (2002).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक कुन ऐनअन्तर्गत स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक ऐन, १९५५ (वि.सं. २०१२) अन्तर्गत स्थापना भयो; हालको शासकीय कानून नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक ऐन, २०५८ (२००२) हो।

question: Nepal Bank Limited was established in which year?
explanation: Nepal Bank Limited was established in 1937 AD (15 Kartik 1994 BS) as Nepal's first commercial bank.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल बैंक लिमिटेड कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: नेपाल बैंक लिमिटेड सन् १९३७ (१५ कार्तिक १९९४) मा नेपालको पहिलो वाणिज्य बैंकका रूपमा स्थापना भयो।

question: Rastriya Banijya Bank was established in which year?
explanation: Rastriya Banijya Bank, a fully government-owned commercial bank, was established on 23 January 1966 (10 Magh 2022 BS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: राष्ट्रिय वाणिज्य बैंक कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: पूर्ण सरकारी स्वामित्वको वाणिज्य बैंक राष्ट्रिय वाणिज्य बैंक २३ जनवरी १९६६ (१० माघ २०२२) मा स्थापना भयो।

question: Which bank is known as the bankers' bank in Nepal?
explanation: The central bank is the bankers' bank — it holds the reserves of commercial banks and lends to them as lender of last resort.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा कुन बैंकलाई बैंकहरूको बैंक भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंक बैंकहरूको बैंक हो — यसले वाणिज्य बैंकहरूको रिजर्भ राख्छ र अन्तिम ऋणदाताका रूपमा ऋण दिन्छ।

question: The currency of Nepal is the:
explanation: Nepal's currency is the Nepalese rupee (NPR); it is pegged to the Indian rupee at 1 INR = 1.60 NPR.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको मुद्रा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: नेपालको मुद्रा नेपाली रुपैयाँ (NPR) हो; यो भारतीय रुपैयाँसँग १ INR = १.६० NPR मा स्थिर छ।

question: The monetary policy of Nepal is formulated by:
explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank formulates and implements monetary policy; the Ministry of Finance handles fiscal policy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको मौद्रिक नीति कसले तर्जुमा गर्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले मौद्रिक नीति तर्जुमा र कार्यान्वयन गर्छ; अर्थ मन्त्रालयले राजस्व नीति हेर्छ।

question: The fiscal policy of Nepal is formulated by:
explanation: Fiscal policy (government revenue and spending, the budget) is the Ministry of Finance's responsibility.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको राजस्व नीति कसले तर्जुमा गर्छ?
explanation_ne: राजस्व नीति (सरकारी राजस्व र खर्च, बजेट) अर्थ मन्त्रालयको जिम्मेवारी हो।

question: CRR in banking stands for:
explanation: Cash Reserve Ratio is the share of deposits banks must keep with the central bank.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकिङमा CRR को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: नगद रिजर्भ अनुपात भनेको बैंकले केन्द्रीय बैंकमा राख्नुपर्ने निक्षेपको अंश हो।

question: SLR in banking stands for:
explanation: Statutory Liquidity Ratio is the share of deposits banks must hold in liquid assets (cash, gold, approved securities).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकिङमा SLR को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: वैधानिक तरलता अनुपात भनेको बैंकले तरल सम्पत्ति (नगद, सुन, स्वीकृत धितोपत्र) मा राख्नुपर्ने निक्षेपको अंश हो।

question: The bank rate is the rate at which:
options: The central bank lends to commercial banks
explanation: The bank rate is the central bank's lending rate to commercial banks; it is a monetary policy tool.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंक दर भनेको कुन दर हो?
options_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकले वाणिज्य बैंकलाई ऋण दिने दर
वाणिज्य बैंकले ग्राहकलाई ऋण दिने दर
explanation_ne: बैंक दर केन्द्रीय बैंकले वाणिज्य बैंकलाई ऋण दिने दर हो; यो मौद्रिक नीतिको औजार हो।

question: The repo rate is the rate at which:
options: Commercial banks borrow short-term funds from the central bank
explanation: Under a repo, banks sell securities to the central bank with an agreement to repurchase them — a short-term borrowing tool.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रिपो दर भनेको कुन दर हो?
options_ne: वाणिज्य बैंकले केन्द्रीय बैंकबाट अल्पकालीन रकम सापटी लिने दर
explanation_ne: रिपोमा बैंकले केन्द्रीय बैंकलाई धितोपत्र बेच्छ र फिर्ता किन्ने सहमति गर्छ — अल्पकालीन सापटी औजार।

question: Inflation means:
options: A general rise in prices and a fall in the purchasing power of money
explanation: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level; deflation is the opposite.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुद्रास्फीति भनेको के हो?
options_ne: मूल्यमा सामान्य वृद्धि र पैसाको क्रयशक्ति घट्नु
explanation_ne: मुद्रास्फीति भनेको सामान्य मूल्यस्तरमा निरन्तर वृद्धि हो; यसको विपरीत मुद्रा अवस्फीति हो।

question: A demand deposit is a deposit that can be withdrawn:
explanation: Demand deposits (current and savings accounts) are payable on demand; fixed deposits are locked for a term.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माग निक्षेप भनेको कुन निक्षेप हो?
options_ne: माग गरेकै बेला जुनसुकै बेला झिक्न सकिने
explanation_ne: माग निक्षेप (चालु र बचत खाता) माग गरेकै बेला तिर्नुपर्छ; मुद्दती निक्षेप अवधिका लागि बन्द हुन्छ।

question: A fixed deposit is a deposit that is:
options: Locked for a fixed term and earns higher interest
explanation: Fixed (term) deposits are kept for a set period and pay higher interest than savings accounts.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुद्दती निक्षेप भनेको कस्तो निक्षेप हो?
options_ne: निश्चित अवधिका लागि बन्द र बढी ब्याज दिने
explanation_ne: मुद्दती (अवधि) निक्षेप निश्चित अवधिका लागि राखिन्छ र बचत खाताभन्दा बढी ब्याज दिन्छ।

question: A current account is mainly used by:
explanation: Current accounts suit businesses with many daily transactions; they usually pay no interest.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चालु खाता मुख्यतः कसले प्रयोग गर्छ?
explanation_ne: चालु खाता दैनिक धेरै कारोबार गर्ने व्यवसायका लागि उपयुक्त हुन्छ; यसले सामान्यतया ब्याज दिँदैन।

question: A savings account is mainly meant for:
options: Individuals to save money and earn interest
explanation: Savings accounts are for individuals to deposit savings and earn interest, with withdrawals allowed.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बचत खाता मुख्यतः कसका लागि हो?
options_ne: व्यक्तिले पैसा बचत गरी ब्याज कमाउन
explanation_ne: बचत खाता व्यक्तिले बचत जम्मा गरी ब्याज कमाउनका लागि हो, झिक्न मिल्छ।

question: Interest on a loan is:
explanation: Interest is the price paid for using borrowed money, usually expressed as an annual percentage of the principal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऋणमा ब्याज भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: ब्याज भनेको सापटी लिएको पैसा प्रयोग गर्ने मूल्य हो, सामान्यतया मूलधनको वार्षिक प्रतिशतमा व्यक्त गरिन्छ।

question: The principal of a loan is:
explanation: The principal is the original sum borrowed, on which interest is calculated.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऋणको मूलधन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: मूलधन भनेको मूल रूपमा सापटी लिएको रकम हो, जसमा ब्याज गणना गरिन्छ।

question: A cheque is a:
options: Written order to a bank to pay a stated sum to a named person
explanation: A cheque instructs the drawer's bank to pay the payee the amount written on it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चेक भनेको के हो?
options_ne: नाम तोकिएको व्यक्तिलाई तोकिएको रकम तिर्न बैंकलाई दिइएको लिखित आदेश
explanation_ne: चेकले जारीकर्ताको बैंकलाई त्यसमा लेखिएको रकम प्राप्तकर्तालाई तिर्न निर्देशन दिन्छ।

question: A crossed cheque can be paid only:
options: Through a bank account (not in cash over the counter)
explanation: Crossing a cheque (two parallel lines) means it must be deposited into a bank account, not cashed over the counter.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्रस गरिएको चेक कसरी मात्र तिर्न सकिन्छ?
explanation_ne: चेक क्रस गर्नु (दुई समानान्तर रेखा) भनेको यो बैंक खातामा जम्मा गर्नुपर्छ, काउन्टरमा नगद झिक्न मिल्दैन।

question: A bearer cheque is payable to:
explanation: A bearer cheque is payable to the bearer — whoever holds and presents it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बाहक चेक कसलाई तिर्न सकिन्छ?
explanation_ne: बाहक चेक बाहकलाई तिर्न सकिन्छ — जसले राख्छ र प्रस्तुत गर्छ उसलाई।

question: An order cheque is payable to:
options: The named payee or their endorsee
explanation: An order cheque is paid to the person named on it (or to whom they endorse it), unlike a bearer cheque.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आदेश चेक कसलाई तिर्न सकिन्छ?
options_ne: नाम तोकिएको प्राप्तकर्ता वा उसले हस्तान्तरण गरेको व्यक्तिलाई
explanation_ne: आदेश चेक त्यसमा नाम तोकिएको व्यक्ति (वा उसले हस्तान्तरण गरेको व्यक्ति) लाई तिरिन्छ, बाहक चेकभन्दा फरक।

question: NEFT in Nepal stands for:
explanation: NEFT (Nepal Electronic Fund Transfer) is a system for electronic transfer of funds between bank accounts in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा NEFT को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: NEFT (नेपाल इलेक्ट्रोनिक फन्ड ट्रान्सफर) नेपालमा बैंक खाताबीच इलेक्ट्रोनिक रूपमा रकम स्थानान्तरण गर्ने प्रणाली हो।

question: RTGS is used mainly for:
explanation: RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement) settles high-value transfers individually in real time.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: RTGS मुख्यतः कुनका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: RTGS (रियल-टाइम ग्रस सेटलमेन्ट) ले उच्च-मूल्य स्थानान्तरणलाई वास्तविक समयमा छुट्टाछुट्टै फर्छ्यौट गर्छ।

question: A bank draft is:
options: A payment instrument issued by a bank on behalf of a customer, guaranteed by the bank
A cheque written by a customer
explanation: A bank draft (demand draft) is drawn by a bank on itself and is guaranteed, so it is safer than a personal cheque.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंक ड्राफ्ट भनेको के हो?
options_ne: ग्राहकको तर्फबाट बैंकले जारी गर्ने भुक्तानी साधन, बैंकले ग्यारेन्टी गरेको
explanation_ne: बैंक ड्राफ्ट (डिमान्ड ड्राफ्ट) बैंकले आफैंमा जारी गर्छ र ग्यारेन्टी हुन्छ, त्यसैले व्यक्तिगत चेकभन्दा सुरक्षित हुन्छ।

question: The lender of last resort in Nepal is:
explanation: As central bank, Nepal Rastra Bank lends to banks in difficulty when no other source will — the lender of last resort.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा अन्तिम ऋणदाता कुन हो?
explanation_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकका रूपमा नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले अन्य स्रोत नभए कठिनाइमा परेका बैंकलाई ऋण दिन्छ — अन्तिम ऋणदाता।

question: The Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON) regulates:
explanation: SEBON regulates Nepal's stock market and securities; Nepal Rastra Bank regulates banks, and the Insurance Board regulates insurers.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल धितोपत्र बोर्ड (SEBON) ले के नियमन गर्छ?
explanation_ne: SEBON ले नेपालको शेयर बजार र धितोपत्र नियमन गर्छ; नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले बैंक र बीमा बोर्डले बीमक नियमन गर्छ।

question: NEPSE stands for:
explanation: NEPSE (Nepal Stock Exchange) is Nepal's only stock exchange, established in 1993 AD.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: NEPSE को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: NEPSE (नेपाल स्टक एक्सचेन्ज) नेपालको एक मात्र शेयर बजार हो, सन् १९९३ मा स्थापित।

question: A share is a:
options: Unit of ownership in a company
explanation: A share represents part-ownership of a company; a debenture or bond is a loan to the company.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शेयर भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: शेयर भनेको कम्पनीमा आंशिक स्वामित्व हो; डिबेन्चर वा बन्ड कम्पनीलाई ऋण हो।

question: A debenture is a:
options: Long-term debt instrument issued by a company
explanation: A debenture is a company's promise to repay borrowed money with interest; holders are creditors, not owners.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डिबेन्चर भनेको के हो?
options_ne: कम्पनीले जारी गर्ने दीर्घकालीन ऋण साधन
explanation_ne: डिबेन्चर भनेको कम्पनीले ब्याजसहित सापटी फिर्ता गर्ने वाचा हो; धारक ऋणदाता हुन्, स्वामी होइनन्।

question: A bond is a:
options: Debt security in which the issuer owes the holder money
explanation: A bond is a loan made by the holder to the issuer (government or company), repaid with interest.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बन्ड भनेको के हो?
options_ne: ऋण धितोपत्र जसमा जारीकर्ताले धारकलाई पैसा तिर्नुपर्छ
explanation_ne: बन्ड भनेको धारकले जारीकर्ता (सरकार वा कम्पनी) लाई दिएको ऋण हो, ब्याजसहित फिर्ता हुन्छ।

question: The NEPSE index measures:
options: The overall performance of the Nepal stock market
explanation: The NEPSE index tracks the market value of listed shares and shows whether the market is rising or falling.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: NEPSE सूचकले के नाप्छ?
explanation_ne: NEPSE सूचकले सूचीकृत शेयरको बजार मूल्य ट्र्याक गर्छ र बजार बढ्दै वा घट्दै छ भनी देखाउँछ।

question: A bull market is a market in which:
explanation: A bull market is a prolonged rise in prices; a bear market is a prolonged fall.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बुल बजार भनेको कस्तो बजार हो?
explanation_ne: बुल बजार भनेको मूल्यमा लामो वृद्धि हो; बियर बजार भनेको लामो गिरावट हो।

question: A bear market is a market in which:
explanation: A bear market is a prolonged fall in prices; a bull market is a prolonged rise.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बियर बजार भनेको कस्तो बजार हो?
explanation_ne: बियर बजार भनेको मूल्यमा लामो गिरावट हो; बुल बजार भनेको लामो वृद्धि हो।

question: The base rate of a bank is:
options: The minimum interest rate a bank charges on loans
explanation: A bank's base rate is the lowest rate it can charge on loans; lending rates are set as base rate plus a premium.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकको आधार दर भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: बैंकको आधार दर भनेको यसले ऋणमा लिन सक्ने सबैभन्दा कम दर हो; ऋण दर आधार दरमा प्रिमियम थपेर निर्धारण गरिन्छ।

question: KYC in banking stands for:
explanation: Know Your Customer means verifying a customer's identity before opening an account or providing services.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बैंकिङमा KYC को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: ग्राहकलाई चिन्नुहोस् भनेको खाता खोल्न वा सेवा दिनुअघि ग्राहकको पहिचान प्रमाणित गर्नु हो।

question: ATM stands for:
explanation: An ATM is an Automated Teller Machine for cash withdrawal and other banking services without a teller.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ATM को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: ATM भनेको टेलरबिना नगद झिक्न र अन्य बैंकिङ सेवा गर्ने स्वचालित टेलर मेसिन हो।

question: The first ATM in Nepal was introduced by:
explanation: Nabil Bank introduced Nepal's first ATM in 1995 AD.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा पहिलो ATM कसले सुरु गर्यो?
explanation_ne: नबिल बैंकले सन् १९९५ मा नेपालको पहिलो ATM सुरु गर्यो।

question: Which is the oldest joint-venture bank in Nepal?
explanation: Nabil Bank (established 1984 AD as Nepal Arab Bank) is Nepal's first joint-venture bank; Standard Chartered Bank Nepal (1987) is also a joint-venture bank.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो संयुक्त उपक्रम बैंक कुन हो?
explanation_ne: नबिल बैंक (सन् १९८४ मा नेपाल अरब बैंकका रूपमा स्थापित) नेपालको पहिलो संयुक्त उपक्रम बैंक हो; स्ट्यान्डर्ड चार्टर्ड बैंक नेपाल (१९८७) पनि संयुक्त उपक्रम बैंक हो।

question: Nabil Bank was established in which year?
explanation: Nabil Bank was established in 1984 AD as Nepal Arab Bank, the country's first joint-venture bank.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नबिल बैंक कुन वर्षमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: नबिल बैंक सन् १९८४ मा नेपाल अरब बैंकका रूपमा देशको पहिलो संयुक्त उपक्रम बैंकका रूपमा स्थापना भयो।

question: The Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund (DCGF) in Nepal guarantees deposits up to:
options: Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank
explanation: DCGF guarantees deposits up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per member institution in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा निक्षेप तथा कर्जा सुरक्षण कोष (DCGF) ले प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति बैंक कतिसम्म निक्षेपको ग्यारेन्टी गर्छ?
explanation_ne: DCGF ले नेपालमा प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति सदस्य संस्था रु. ५ लाखसम्म निक्षेपको ग्यारेन्टी गर्छ।

question: A non-performing loan (NPL) is a loan on which:
options: Interest or principal has not been paid for 90 days or more
explanation: A loan is classified as non-performing when payments are overdue, commonly by 90 days.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: निष्क्रिय कर्जा (NPL) भनेको कस्तो ऋण हो?
options_ne: ९० दिन वा बढी ब्याज वा मूलधन नतिरिएको ऋण
explanation_ne: भुक्तानी ढिलो भएमा, सामान्यतया ९० दिनले, ऋणलाई निष्क्रियका रूपमा वर्गीकरण गरिन्छ।

question: GNP stands for:
explanation: GNP is GDP plus net income from abroad (income earned by residents abroad minus income earned by foreigners domestically).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: GNP को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: GNP भनेको GDP मा विदेशबाट शुद्ध आय (विदेशमा रहेका बासिन्दाले कमाएको आय घटाई देशभित्र विदेशीले कमाएको आय) थपिएको हो।

question: GDP per capita is calculated as:
explanation: GDP per capita = total GDP / total population; it is a rough measure of average income.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रतिव्यक्ति GDP कसरी गणना गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रतिव्यक्ति GDP = कुल GDP / कुल जनसंख्या; यो औसत आयको अनुमानित माप हो।

question: The largest sector of Nepal's economy by share of GDP is:
explanation: Services contribute the largest share of Nepal's GDP (over half), followed by agriculture (about one-quarter) and industry.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: GDP मा हिस्साअनुसार नेपालको अर्थतन्त्रको सबैभन्दा ठूलो क्षेत्र कुन हो?
explanation_ne: सेवाले नेपालको GDP मा सबैभन्दा ठूलो हिस्सा (आधाभन्दा बढी) योगदान गर्छ, त्यसपछि कृषि (लगभग एक चौथाइ) र उद्योग।

question: Agriculture contributes about what share of Nepal's GDP?
explanation: Agriculture contributes roughly one-quarter of Nepal's GDP but employs about two-thirds of the workforce.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कृषिले नेपालको GDP मा लगभग कति हिस्सा योगदान गर्छ?
explanation_ne: कृषिले नेपालको GDP मा लगभग एक चौथाइ योगदान गर्छ तर लगभग दुई तिहाइ श्रमशक्ति रोजगारी दिन्छ।

question: About what share of Nepal's workforce is employed in agriculture?
explanation: Agriculture employs roughly 60–65% of Nepal's workforce, although it produces only about a quarter of GDP.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको श्रमशक्तिको लगभग कति हिस्सा कृषिमा रोजगारी गर्छ?
explanation_ne: कृषिले नेपालको श्रमशक्तिको लगभग ६०–६५% लाई रोजगारी दिन्छ, यद्यपि यसले GDP को लगभग एक चौथाइ मात्र उत्पादन गर्छ।

question: The main source of foreign exchange earnings for Nepal is:
explanation: Remittances from Nepali workers abroad are Nepal's largest source of foreign exchange, exceeding one-quarter of GDP in recent years.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालका लागि विदेशी मुद्रा आर्जनको मुख्य स्रोत के हो?
explanation_ne: विदेशमा रहेका नेपाली श्रमिकबाट आउने रेमिट्यान्स नेपालको विदेशी मुद्राको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्रोत हो, हालका वर्षमा GDP को एक चौथाइभन्दा बढी।

question: Nepal's second largest trading partner is generally:
explanation: China is generally Nepal's second largest trading partner, mainly as a source of imports.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालको दोस्रो ठूलो व्यापारिक साझेदार सामान्यतया कुन हो?
explanation_ne: चीन सामान्यतया नेपालको दोस्रो ठूलो व्यापारिक साझेदार हो, मुख्यतः आयात स्रोतका रूपमा।

question: Nepal is a member of SAARC since its founding in:
explanation: SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) was founded in Dhaka on 8 December 1985 with Nepal as a founding member.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल SAARC को संस्थापक सदस्य कहिलेदेखि हो?
explanation_ne: SAARC (दक्षिण एसियाली क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संगठन) ८ डिसेम्बर १९८५ मा ढाकामा स्थापना भयो, नेपाल संस्थापक सदस्य हो।

question: SAARC was founded in which city?
explanation: SAARC was founded in Dhaka, Bangladesh, on 8 December 1985; its secretariat is in Kathmandu.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: SAARC कुन सहरमा स्थापना भयो?
explanation_ne: SAARC ८ डिसेम्बर १९८५ मा बंगलादेशको ढाकामा स्थापना भयो; यसको सचिवालय काठमाडौंमा छ।

question: The headquarters (secretariat) of SAARC is located in:
explanation: The SAARC Secretariat is in Kathmandu, Nepal, since its establishment in 1987.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: SAARC को मुख्यालय (सचिवालय) कहाँ छ?
explanation_ne: SAARC सचिवालय सन् १९८७ मा स्थापनादेखि काठमाडौं, नेपालमा छ।

question: The National Planning Commission of Nepal was established in:
explanation: The National Planning Commission was established in 1956 AD (2013 BS) to formulate development plans.

explanation_ne: राष्ट्रिय योजना आयोग सन् १९५६ (वि.सं. २०१३) मा विकास योजना तर्जुमा गर्न स्थापना भयो।

question: Nepal's first Five-Year Plan began in which year?
explanation: Nepal's First Five-Year Plan ran from 1956 to 1961 (2013–2018 BS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

explanation_ne: नेपालको पहिलो पञ्चवर्षीय योजना सन् १९५६ देखि १९६१ (वि.सं. २०१३–२०१८) सम्म चल्यो।

explanation_ne: संवैधानिक व्यवस्थाअनुसार वार्षिक बजेट प्रत्येक वर्ष १५ जेठ (२९ मे) मा प्रस्तुत गरिन्छ।

explanation_ne: नेपालको आर्थिक वर्ष ३१ असार (जुलाई मध्य) मा समाप्त हुन्छ।

question: The budget for FY 2082/83 (2025/26) of Nepal was presented on:

question: The total size of Nepal's budget for FY 2082/83 (2025/26) was about:

explanation: Finance Minister Bishnu Prasad Paudel presented the FY 2082/83 budget on 29 May 2025.

explanation_ne: अर्थमन्त्री विष्णुप्रसाद पौडेलले आ.व. २०८२/८३ को बजेट २९ मे २०२५ मा प्रस्तुत गरे।

question: In Nepal's FY 2082/83 budget, the largest share was allocated to:

explanation_ne: आ.व. २०८२/८३ को बजेटमा चालु खर्च लगभग रु. १.१८ ट्रिलियन (६०.१३%), पुँजीगत लगभग रु. ४०७ अर्ब (२०.७७%) र वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन लगभग रु. ३७५ अर्ब (१९.१०%) थियो।

question: The growth target of Nepal's FY 2082/83 budget was:

explanation_ne: आ.व. २०८२/८३ को बजेटले ६% आर्थिक वृद्धि लक्ष्य राखेको थियो।

question: A trade deficit means a country:

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: व्यापार घाटा भनेको देशले के गर्छ?
explanation_ne: आयातको मूल्य निर्यातको मूल्यभन्दा बढी भए व्यापार घाटा हुन्छ; नेपालमा ठूलो व्यापार घाटा छ।

question: A trade surplus means a country:
explanation: A trade surplus occurs when the value of exports exceeds the value of imports.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: व्यापार नाफा (अधिशेष) भनेको देशले के गर्छ?
explanation_ne: निर्यातको मूल्य आयातको मूल्यभन्दा बढी भए व्यापार नाफा हुन्छ।

question: The balance of payments records:

explanation_ne: भुक्तानी सन्तुलन भनेको देशका बासिन्दा र बाँकी विश्वबीचका सबै कारोबारको व्यवस्थित अभिलेख हो।

question: Foreign direct investment (FDI) means:

explanation_ne: FDI मा विदेशी लगानीकर्ताले विदेशको उद्यममा दीर्घकालीन चासो (सामान्यतया मताधिकारको १०% वा बढी) प्राप्त गर्छ।

question: The poverty rate in Nepal (as measured by the Nepal Living Standards Survey) is about:
